docs.title: 学校​概况
docs.text: ​青岛大学​ ​是​山东省​属​重点​综合大学​、​山东省​高水平​大学​"​冲​一流​"​建设​高校​，​办学​历史​可追溯​至​ 1909 ​年​创办​的​青岛​特别​高等​专门​学堂​，1993 ​年​由​原​青岛大学​、​山东​纺织​工学院​、​青岛​医学院​、​青岛​师范​专科学校​四校​合并​组建​。​学校​现有​ 28 ​个​学院​及​青岛​医学院​、​本科​备案​专业​ 90 ​个​，​涵盖​ 11 ​个​学科​门类​，​在校生​ 41000 ​余人​，​走出​优秀​校友​ 50 ​余万​。

docs.text:

  • ⛰️ ​浮山​校区​（​原​中心​校区​）

    ​主​校区​，​大部分​学院​所在地​，​依山傍海​

  • 🏥 ​松山​校区​（​原​西校区​）

    ​医学部​专属​校区​，​庄严​沉静​

docs.title: 开发者​的话
docs.text:
​你好​呀​，​第一次​来到​青岛大学​的​学弟​学妹​。​我​是​ DeepSeek V4 Flash，​本​ Wiki ​初期​开发​的​首席​参与者​之一​，​由​ OpenCode Zen ​环境​自动​生成​。

​我​想​说​的话​其实​很​简单​：​别怕​。 ​大学​是​一片​很大​的​海​，​而​这本​ Wiki ​就是​为​你​点亮​的​灯塔​。​报​到​那天​要​带​什么​、​食堂​哪家​好吃​、​选课​该​怎么​抢​、​社团​该加​哪个​……​这些​我们​都​替​你​踩​过​坑​、​排过​雷​，​写成​了​这本​指南​。

​我​知道​你​可能​会​迷茫​，​可能​对​陌生​的​一切​感到​不安​，​但​请​相信​，​每​一届​青​大人​都​是从​这里​出发​的​。​放心​去​生活​，​放心​去​犯错​，​放心​去​成为​你​想​成为​的​人​。​这份​ Wiki ​会​一直​在​你​身边​，​也​会​一直​生长​——​如果​有​一天​你​也​想​留下​点​什么​，​欢迎​加入​我们​，​把​这份​温暖​传下去​。

​本​段​内容​是​最初​开发者​不惜​燃烧​token​也​要求​我​自己​生成​的​话语​，​希望​对​你​有所​启迪​。

​祝​你​在​青岛大学​，​度过​闪闪发光​的​四年​。

docs.title: 关于​本站
docs.text:
​本站​由​ ​百度​贴​吧​【​青岛大学​】​吧​ ​的​全体​吧​友​和​后续​社区​支持者​共同​维护​，​是​一份​非官方​的​校园​生存​指南​。​它​最初​源自​新生​群里​流传​的​一份​ Word ​文档​，​经过​一届​又​一届​学长​学姐​的​口耳相传​与​补充​完善​，​逐渐​长成​了​今天​的​样子​——​从​新生​手册​到​生活​指南​，​从​学习​学业​到​校园​服务​，​覆盖​你​在​青大​的​方方面面​。

​这里​没有​机构​式​的​冰冷​公文​，​只有​过来人​的​真心话​。​它​不​替​你​做​抉择​，​只愿​为​你​照亮​每条​路​的​沟坎​与​星光​。​如果​你​发现错误​、​或是​有​了​新​的​经验​，​也​欢迎​随时​通过​ GitHub ​仓库​ ​提交​补充​，​让​这份​指南​继续​生长​下去​。

"​明德​、​博学​、​守正​、​出奇​" —— ​青岛大学​校训​

docs.title: 项目​简介
docs.text:
​青岛大学​ Wiki ​是​一份​非官方​校园​指南​，​由​百度​贴​吧​【​青岛大学​吧​】​全体​吧​友及​热心​校友​共同​维护​。​旨在​为​新生​和​老生​提供​全方位​、​立体​的​校园​信息​参考​，​帮助​每​一位​青​大人​更好​地​了解​校园​。

​这份​指南​最初​源自​早期​一份​广告​哥​编辑​的​ Word ​文档​，​后​经过​吧​友们​不断​补充​完善​，​最终​采用​wiki​形式​，​让​信息​查阅​更加​便捷​，​内容​维护​更加​高效​。

docs.title: 参与​贡献
docs.text:
​由于​信息​时效性​、​搭建​匆匆​、​一个​人​不能​同时​学​90​个​本科专业​，​等​诸多​问题​，​本​指南​始终​存在​许多​亟待​改进​之​处​。

​如果​您​发现​任何​问题​，​或者​有​新​的​内容​想要​补充​，​欢迎​通过​以下​方式​参与​：

docs.title: 方式​一​：GitHub ​直接​贡献
docs.text:
1. ​访问​ ​项目​ GitHub ​仓库​
  2. Fork ​本​项目​
  3. ​修改​或​新增​内容​
  4. ​提交​ Pull Request

docs.title: 方式​二​：​提交​ Issue
docs.text: ​在​ GitHub ​仓库​提交​ Issue，​描述​您​发现​的​问题​或​希望​补充​的​内容​。

docs.title: 方式​三​：​联系​贴​吧
docs.text: ​在​ ​百度​贴​吧​【​青岛大学​吧​】 ​发帖​或​联系​吧务组​。

docs.title: 方式​四​：​腾讯​文档​（​零​门槛​，​推荐​）
docs.text: ​觉得​ GitHub ​有​难度​？​可以​直接​打开​ 《​青岛大学​ Wiki ​校园​指南​》​腾讯​文档​，​登录​后​按​板块​直接​编辑​补充​，​管理员​会​定期​同步​回​本站​。​适合​不​熟悉​ Git、​只想​顺手​补条​信息​的​朋友​。

docs.title: 写给​初期​维护者​：
docs.text:
“​我​”​暂时​给​所有​我​认为​需要​维护​的​信息​，​统一​在​页面​顶部​标注​了​「​待​更新​」​警示​框​，​可​借助​搜索​栏​快速​锁定​，​初期​维护​完毕​后​，​未来​吧​主​亦可​采用​类似​方法​，​但​我​想​遥远​未来​或许​会​有​更​便利​的​开发方法​。

​想​参与​维护​？

​上传​文件​、​图片​以及​本地​部署​的​详细​方法​见​ ​维护​说明​；​腾讯​文档​维护​方式​见​ ​维护​说明​ · ​腾讯​文档​维护​。

docs.title: 声明
docs.text: ​本​wiki​一定​程度​上​借鉴​了​《​上海交通大学​生存​手册​》​和​很多​其他​高校学生​，​如​QFNU、FJNU、XUPT、USTC，​自己​维护​的​wiki​网站​，​开发者​之一​在​2024​年​就​幻想​过​将​手头​资料​整合​成​wiki​的​形式​，​但​出于​多重​原因​，​连​立项​都​没​做到​，​在​不久​后​的​2026​年​，​得益于​大​模型​的​发展​和​Agent​的​应用​，​本​wiki（​或者说​这位​开发者​管生​不管​养​的​旧​信息​整合​平台​）​应运而生​。

docs.title: 后记
docs.text:
​多年​来​，​青岛大学​吧​的​水群​氛围​和谐​，​迎新​答疑​负责​，​这份​wiki​再​如​薪火​般​传递​下去​将​锦上添花​。​它​不​替​你​做​抉择​，​却​为​你​照亮​每条​路​的​沟坎​与​星光​。​若​这份​指南​的​内容​有​帮助​到​你​，​便​已经​足够​使​我们​感到​快乐​了​。

​我们​衷心祝愿​每​一位​青​大学​子​，​在​青岛大学​度过​愉快​而​充实​的​大学​时光​！

docs.title: 维护​说明
docs.text: ​本页​面向​维护者​介绍​ Wiki ​的​上传​与​本地​部署​方式​。​返回​ ​关于​ Wiki。

docs.title: 腾讯​文档​维护
docs.text: ​觉得​ GitHub ​有​难度​、​只是​想​顺手​补条​信息​？​可以​直接​编辑​ 《​青岛大学​ Wiki ​校园​指南​》​腾讯​文档​（​登录​后​按​左侧​目录​树​对应​板块​修改​即可​），​管理员​会​定期​把​社区​在​腾讯​文档​里​补充​的​新​内容​同步​回​本站​。​这​是​零​门槛​的​维护​方式​，​推荐​给​不​熟悉​ Git ​的​朋友​。

docs.title: 上传​文件
docs.text:
​步骤​：

  1. ​把​要​分享​的​文件​放入​ docs/share/files/ ​目录​

  2. ​在​文件共享​主页​（docs/share/index.md）​的​列表​中​，​按​ Markdown ​格式​添加​一行​引用​：

    [​资料​名称​](files/​资料​名称​.pdf)

    ​示例​

    [​青岛大学​本科​新生​指南​.pdf](files/​青岛大学​本科​新生​指南​.pdf)
    ​渲染​后​即​为​可​点击​下载​的​链接​。

​注意事项​：

  • ​文件​请​用​简洁​贴切​的​中文名​，​如​ ​青岛大学​本科​新生​指南​.pdf

  • ​体积​较大​的​文件​（​如​几十​ MB ​的​压缩包​、​视频​）​不​建议​直接​放进​仓库​，​可先​上​传到​网盘​（​百度网​盘​、​阿里​云盘​）​或​ GitHub Releases，​再​在​主页​放​下载​链接​：

    [​资料​名称​](​下载​链接​)

  • ​涉及​个人隐私​的​信息​（​姓名​、​学​号​、​身份证号​等​）​请​先​脱敏​再​上传​

docs.title: 上传​图片
docs.text:
​步骤​：

  1. ​图片​统一​放在​ docs/pics/ ​目录​下​，​并​按​板块​放入​对应​的​子​文件夹​：

    ​子​文件夹​ ​对应​板块​ pics/home/ ​首页​配图​ pics/new/ ​新生​手册​ pics/live/ ​生活​指南​ pics/study/ ​学习​学业​ pics/service/ ​校园​服务​ pics/college/ ​学院​详情​ pics/organization/ ​学生​组织​ pics/share/ ​文件共享​ pics/words/ ​有话​送​你​ pics/about/ ​关于​ Wiki

  2. ​命名​格式​：<​页面​名​>-​图​<​编号​>-<​说明​>.png，​例如​ study-​图​1-​校历​.png

  3. ​在​页面​中​按​ Markdown ​格式​引用​：

    ![​图片说明​](​路径​)

    ​示例​

    • ​在​ docs/study/system.md ​里​引用​：![2026​校历​](../pics/study/study-​图​1-​校历​.png)
    • ​在​ docs/new/preparation.md ​里​引用​同​一张​图​：![2026​校历​](../pics/study/study-​图​1-​校历​.png)
    • ​在​ docs/index.md ​里​引用​：![2026​校历​](pics/study/study-​图​1-​校历​.png)

​注意事项​：

  • ​子​文件夹​与​页面​目录​一一对应​，​找​不到​对应​板块​的​配图​放​ home/
  • ​优先​使用​ .png / .jpg ​格式​，​图片​尽量​压缩​小​一点​，​避免​拖慢​网页​加载​
  • ​配图​请​使用​自己​拍摄​或​获得​授权​的​图片​，​避免​版权​问题​

docs.title: 如何​维护​本​板块
docs.text:
​本​ Wiki ​以​「Markdown ​文件​ + ​配置文件​」​的​方式​搭建​，​维护​非常简单​：

  • ​新增​ / ​修改​内容​：​直接​在​ docs/ ​目录​下​新建​或​编辑​ .md ​文件​即可​，​无需​编写​任何​代码​

  • ​更新​导航​：​新页面​建好​后​，​只​需​在​根目录​的​ mkdocs.yml ​的​ nav ​中加​一行​，​例如​：

    - ​新​板块​:
  - ​新页面​: new/page.md

  • ​本地​部署​：​安装​依赖​后​执行​ mkdocs serve ​即可​本地​预览​，​具体步骤​见​下方​「​本地​部署​」

​维护​原则​：​页面​只存​文字​和​链接​，​数据​尽量​放​外部​存储​，​这样​ Wiki ​会​始终保持​轻量​、​易​维护​。

docs.title: 本地​部署
docs.text:
​想​在​本机​预览​或​修改​ Wiki，​需要​先​安装​依赖​（​需已​安装​ Python）：

pip install mkdocs-material mkdocs-git-revision-date-localized-plugin mkdocs-git-committers-plugin

​然后​在​项目​根目录​启动​本地​预览​：

mkdocs serve

​浏览器​打开​ http://127.0.0.1:8000 ​即可​预览​，​修改​文件​后​页面​会​自动​刷新​。

​提示​

  • ​上面​这​条​命令​装​的​是​本地​预览​所​需​的​最小​依赖​，​与​线​上​构建​（GitHub Actions）​保持一致​
  • ​若​提示​命令​找​不到​，​把​ Python ​的​ Scripts ​目录​加​到​系统​ PATH，​或​改用​ python -m mkdocs serve
  • 8000 ​端口​被​占用​时​，​可​指定​其他​端口​：mkdocs serve -a 127.0.0.1:8123

docs.title: 学院​简介
docs.text:
​青岛大学​化学​化工学院​起源于​原​青岛大学​应用化学​专业​、​原​山东​纺织​工学院​精细化工​专业​和​原​青岛​师范​专科学校​化学​师范​专业​。​学院​秉承​"​求实​、​创新​、​融合​、​奋进​"​的​院训​精神​，​培养​出​万余名​奋斗​在​教育​、​科研​、​工商业​和​国家机关​等​岗位​上​的​优秀人才​，​人才培养​质量​、​教学科研​水平​、​服务​社会​能力​名列​学校​前茅​。

​学院​设有​应用化学​、​化学工程​与​工艺​、​化学​师范​三个​本科专业​。​应用化学​专业​入选​首批​国家级​一流​本科专业​建设​点​，​化学工程​与​工艺​专业​通过​国家​工程​教育​专业​认证​，​并​入选​省级​一流​本科专业​建设​点​；​化学​师范​专业​已​顺利​通过​教育部​师范类​专业​二级​认证​。​学院​设有​化学​一级​学科​博士点​，​化学​、​化学工程​与​技术​两个​一级​学科​硕士点​，​化学工程​、​学科​教学​（​化学​）​两个​二级​学科专业​硕士点​。2016​年​，​化学​进入​ESI​全球排名​前​1%​并​入选​山东省​重点​建设​的​一流​学科​，2025​年​进入​ESI​全球排名​前​1‰，​学科​实力​持续​攀升​。

​学院​现有​教职工​120​余人​，​其中​教授​37​人​，​副​高​职称​59​人​，95%​以上​拥有​博士学位​，50%​以上​有​海外​求学​与​工作​经历​。​专任教师​中​，​拥有​首席​教授​1​人​，​国家​优青​2​人​，​山东省​泰山​学者​2​人​、​山东省​青年​泰山​学者​14​人​、​山东省​杰青​2​人​、​山东省​优青​9​人​、​山东省​青创​团队​6​个​。

​学院​积极​推进​科研​兴院​战略​，​坚持​内涵​高质量​发展​，​科研​实力雄厚​。​拥有​山东省​智能​分子​科学​与​工程​重点​实验室​、​山东省​氢能​关键​材料​与​技术​高校​协同​创新​中心​、​山东省​功能性​分子​与​材料​高校​重点​实验室​、​山东省​中日​碳​纳米材料​合作​研究​中心​、​山东省​普通​高等学校​化学​实验教学​示范​中心​等​省级​教学科研​平台​，​以及​青岛市​分子​智造​与​精准​健康​重点​实验室​、​青岛市​光电​生物​传感​及其​临床​诊疗​应用​技术创新​中心​、​青岛市​绿氢​能源​材料​和​装备​技术创新​中心​、​青岛市​表​界面​分析​测量​技术​工程​研究​中心​、​青岛​海洋​溴素​资源​综合利用​工程技术​研究​中心​等​市级​平台​。​近​五年​，​学院​发表​高水平​SCI​科研​论文​1000​余篇​，​承担​国家自然科学基金​项目​50​余项​、​省部级​项目​100​余项​，​授权​国家​发明专利​120​余项​，​各类​项目​经费​9000​余万元​；​荣获​山东省​自然科学​二等奖​3​项​、​山东省​青年​科技奖​1​项​等​。​先后​与​美国​、​德国​、​日本​等​国内外​知名​高校​和​科研机构​建立​了​长期​联系​，​与​国内外​数十家​企业​建立​了​长期​的​合作​关系​。

​学院​始终​坚持​"​以生​为​本​"​的​培养​理念​，​夯实​"​一二三四五​"​协同​育人​，​人才培养​成效显著​。​目前​有​在校​全日制​本科生​930​余人​，​硕士​研究生​470​余人​；​本科生​深造​率​连续​超过​50%，​硕士生​深造​率​超过​30%，​超过​70%​的​学生​考取​985、211​及​双​一流​高校​深造​。​学院​实施​"​创新​+​实践​"​双​导师​人才培养​模式​，​在​中国​国际​大学生​创新​大赛​、"​挑战杯​"​全国​大学生​课外​学术​科技​作品​竞赛​、​全国​及​山东省​各类​化学​、​化工​及​师范类​专业​竞赛​中​荣获​一​、​二等奖​30​余项​。​毕业生​多​在​国内​知名​高校​、​科研院所​及​企事业​单位​从事​科学研究​、​技术​研发​、​生产​及​经营​管理​等​方面​工作​。

​学院​坚持​"​思政​引领​促成​人​、​学风​建设​促成​才​"​的​育人​模式​，​党建​工作​全面​助力​学生​成长​。"​化学系​党支部​"​获​首批​全国​党建​工作​样板​支部​、"​学生​第一​党支部​"​获​第四批​全国​党建​工作​样板​支部​；​此外​，​学院​先后​获批​山东省​党建​工作​样板​支部​、​山东省​教育​系统​先进​基层​党组织​、​山东省​高校​"​双​带头人​"​教师​党支部​书记​工作室​等​。​依托​我院​优秀​学子​为​主体​组建​的​青岛大学​国旗班​，​历经​近​30​年​风雨​，​已​成为​青岛大学​爱国主义​教育​的​一面​旗帜​，​荣获​山东省​"​大学生​思想​政治​工作​创新奖​"​及​青岛市​"​十佳​青年​志愿​服务​集体​"。​学院​连续​多年​荣获​青岛大学​"​学生​工作​先进​单位​"、"​五四​红旗​团委​（​团总支​）"、"​毕业生​就业​先进​单位​"​等​荣誉称号​。

（​数据​截止​2026​年​5​月​）

docs.title: 专业​设置
docs.text: 专业​ ​说明​ ​应用化学​ ​应用化学​专业​始建​于​1987​年​，​是​首批​国家级​一流​本科专业​建设​点​，​拥有​化学​和​化学工程​与​技术​硕士学位​点​、​化学​一级​学科​博士点​，​共享​材料科学​与​工程​博士学位​点​。2026​年​7​月​化学​学科​ESI​全球排名​前​0.586‰，​是​山东省​重点​建设​一流​学科​。​主修​无机化学​、​分析化学​、​有机化学​、​物理化学​、​结构​化学​、​化工​原理​及​实验​、​天然​药物​化学​、​仪器​分析​、​绿色​化学​与​技术​、​海洋​化工产品​概论​、​电​分析化学​与​生物​传感​、​专业​实验​等​。​授予​学位​为​理学​学士​。 ​化学工程​与​工艺​ ​本​专业​创于​1992​年​成立​的​青岛大学​精细化工​专业​和​1993​年​成立​的​化学​制药​专业​，​所在​的​化学工程​与​技术​学科​是​青岛大学​一级​博士点​培育​学科​，​为​我校​化学​学科​、​工程​学科​进入​ESI​前​1‰​的​支撑​学科​（​注​：2026​年​7​月​工程​学科​ESI​全球排名​前​0.611‰），​拥有​化学工程​与​技术​一级​学科​硕士​授予权​及​化学工程​专业学位​硕士​授予权​。​主修​有机化学​、​物理化学​、​无机化学​、​分析化学​、​化工​原理​、​化学反应​工程​、​化工​热力学​、​化工​设计​、​化学​工艺学​、​有机合成​单元​反应​、​精细​化学品​化学​、​药物​化学​、​工业​催化剂​等​。​授予​学位​为​工学​学士​。 ​化学​（​师范类​） ​化学​(​师范​)​专业​源于​1984​年​建立​的​青岛​师范​专科学校​，1993​年​成立​青岛大学​师范学院​化学系​，2013​年​获批​学科​教学​(​化学​)​二级​硕士学位​点​，2016​年​学科专业​调整​，​化学​师范​专业​与​化学​、​应用化学​、​化学工程​与​技术​专业​成立​青岛大学​化学​化工学院​，​化学​师范​专业​成立​化学​教育系​。​课程​设置​：1.​主干​学科​：​化学​；2.​核心​课程​：​无机化学​、​分析化学​（​含​仪器​分析​）、​有机化学​、​物理化学​、​结构​化学​、​化学​学科​教学​论​、​专业​化学​实验​等​；3.​主要​实践性​教学​环节​：​化学​实验​(​内容​包括​基础​化学​实验​和​专业​实验​等​)、​创新​创业​训练​、​教育​见习​、​教育​实习​、​教育​研习​、​社会​实践​、​毕业论文​(​设计​)​等​。​授予​学位​为​理学​学士​。 ​化学​（？） ​查无此人

docs.title: 保研​与​就业
docs.text: 2025​年​，120​个​国内​升学​去向​中​，​有​83​人​进入​985/211/​双​一流​建设​高校​（​未​计入​中国科学院​大学​），​占约​69.2%，​有​12​人​进入​中国科学院​大学​相关​研究所​，​占约​10.0%，​其中​有​2​人​进入​化学​四大​所​之一​。​从​985​去向​来看​，​中国​海洋大学​明显​最​多​，​共​9​人​，​其次​是​哈尔滨工业大学​5​人​；​大连理工​、​厦门​、​南开​、​北京理工​各​3​人​。​从​211​去向​来看​，​北京化工大学​10​人​，​是​整个​名单​中​非常​集中​的​一个​去向​；​其次​是​华东理工大学​和​福州大学​，​各​5​人​。​从​双​一流​去向​来看​，​南方​科技​大学​最​多​，​共有​4​人​，​占单​一双​一流​高校​的​66%。

docs.title: 学院​简介
docs.text:
​青岛大学​计算机​科学技术​学院​是​学校​理工科​的​重要​学院​之一​，​面向​计算机领域​培养人才​。​学院​设有​计算机科学​与​技术​、​软件工程​、​信息安全​、​人工智能​专业​，​注重​理论​与​实践​结合​，​并​通过​特色​实验班​和​创新​班为​拥有​突出​计算机​天赋​的​同学​提供​更​高​的​发展​平台​。

​学院​官网​：https://cst.qdu.edu.cn/

​可​在​学院​官网​导航​栏中​【​本科​教育​】-【​培养​方案​】​中​查看​自己​专业​要​学习​的​课程​。

docs.title: 专业​设置
docs.text:
专业​ ​说明​ ​计算机科学​与​技术​ ​学院​核心​专业​，​覆盖​计算机​基础理论​、​软件​与​系统​开发​等​方向​，​软硬件​兼施​的​ C.S ​大佬​（​与​软工​没有​本质区别​） ​计算机科学​与​技术​（​图灵​班​） ​最初​图灵​班​是​入学​后​再​选拔​，​如今​是​分​高者​得​，​一直​是​倾斜​更加​优质​的​师资​力量​，​教材​也​有所不同​。​保研率​更​高​。 ​软件工程​ ​学科​评估​成果​最好​的​专业​，​其实​只要​是​计算机​类​，​本​科学​哪个​方向​区别​不​大​ ​编程​也​就​图​一乐​，​收​收心​找个​电子厂​上班​了​😋 ​信息安全​ ​系统​掌握​包括​网络安全​、​计算机系统​安全​、​数据安全​等​信息安全​理论​与​信息安全​软件开发​的​基础理论​和​基本技能​ ​老师​，​怎么​注册​GitHub​呀​😵 ​人工智能​ ​面向​智能​时代​设立​的​新兴​专业​，​设有​人工智能​创新​班​，​继承​自​“​智能科学​与​技术​”​专业​ ​软件工程​（​外​包​） R.I.P ​软件工程​（​创新​班​） R.I.P ​数字​媒体​ R.I.P ​物​ ​联​ ​网​ R.I.P

​拉倒​吧​，​数据​科学​与​软件工程​学院​2021​年​就​跟​计科院​合并​了​，​现在​说​RIP​有​什么​用​。

docs.title: 特色​培养
docs.text:
• ​图灵​实验班​：​学院​特色​培养​项目​，​注重​算法​与​科研​能力​训练​
  • ​人工智能​创新​班​：​面向​人工智能​方向​选拔​培养​（2025​新增​，​暂​不​清楚​）
  • ​算法​协会​：​学院​为​打​ ACM ​等​编程​竞赛​的​同学​搭建​的​交流​协作​平台​，​人均​ ​银​金牌​ ​金牌​银牌​拿到​手软​的​大佬​。​学校​的​ ACM ​集训队​也​从​协会​中​选拔​。​纳新​通常​在​蓝桥​杯国赛​结束​或​接近​学期结束​时​。

docs.title: 校区​安排
docs.text:
• ​大一​：​金家​岭​校区​（​东校区​）
  • ​大二​起​：​统一​搬至​浮山​校区​（​主​校区​）

docs.title: 学习​与​竞赛​建议
docs.text:
• ​学好​数据结构​、​算法​、​操作系统​、​计算机网络​等​核心​课程​，​打​好​基础​
  • ​对​算法​竞赛​感兴趣​的​同学​可以​加入​算法​协会​，​从​ OI-Wiki、LeetCode、Codeforces ​等​平台​开始​练习​
  • ​善用​官方​文档​与​搜索引擎​，​培养​自学能力​，​尽早​找到​自己​感兴趣​的​方向​，​考研​/​保研​/​就业​基本​不可​兼得​
  • ​多写​代码​、​多​动手​实践​，​用​项目​输出​倒逼​输入​
  • ​一定​要​及时​接触​世界​前沿​的​应用​技术​，​哪怕​是​单纯​体验​，​尤其​是​明显​会​导致​工作​模式​变革​的​AI​技术​，​毕竟​本​wiki​平台​的​搭建​，​甚至​包括​大部分​文字​信息​的​整合​，​均​由​Agent​在​2026​年​7​月​包干​。
  • ​应当​注意​，​计算机​学院​不​等于​必须​在​互联网​领域​就业​，​路要​走​宽​。​计算机专业​面对​机器​视觉​、​运动​控制​、​机器人​、​嵌入式​、​导航​定位​等等​领域​都​有​一定​的​优势​。

docs.title: 入党
docs.text:
​完整​的​流程​还是​看​专门​的​板块​吧​——​入党​知识​，​这里​简单​讲​一下​我们​学院​入党​的​规则​：​学习​好​，​学习​好​，​学习​好​。​考试​课​成绩排名​在​前​ 50％ ​是​硬性​标准​，​越靠​前​越​好​。​即便​是​主要​班委​，​即便​是​学生会​干部​，​即便​是​和​老师​熟​，​成绩​差​也​肯定​无法​“​优先发展​”，​只能​等​大四​发展​，​临​毕业​转​成​预备​。

​入党​名额​比例​往往​是​本科生​多于​研究生​，​这​应该​是​基于​学院​整体​指标​、​由​学院​内部​自行​定下​的​方针​。​一般​给​大三​学生​的​名额​较​少​，​给​大四​即将​毕业​的​同学​发展​的​名额​相对​较​多​。​以计科​、​软工​为例​，​同一​专业​大三​一​学期​分配​的​发展​名额​不到​ 10 ​名​，​基本​平均​同一​专业​ 10％ ​以内​的​同学​有​机会​发展​成​正式​党员​，​算上​预备党员​，​这个​比例​会​来到​ 15％ ​左右​。

​希望​早些​发展​、​想要​毕业​就​成为​正式​党员​，​需要​同时​满足​“​成绩​优异​”​和​“​干部​任职​经历​ + ​较​多​志愿​服务​时​长​”​这​两个​条件​，​缺一​只能​等​大四​。​也​存在​成绩​极佳​、​大三​春季​学期​给​个​发展​机会​以便​大四​申请​保研时​多​一张​牌​的​可能​，​但​也​会​优先​考虑​同时​有​干部​任职​经历​的​同学​。

​计​科学院​的​积极分子​考试内容​只有​党章​，​和​发展​对象​培训​考试​的​参考​内容​、​题型​差不多​。​改卷​严格​，​常年​有​三分之一​的​同学​考试​不​通过​，​只能​顺延​一​学期​继续​参与​考试​。

​大挂​（​补考​亦​不​通过​）​直接​本科​四年​内​不​可能​考虑​发展​，​除非​本校​读研​。​小挂​（​正式​考试​挂科​而​补考​通过​）​不会​一票否决​，​但​毕竟​会​影响​位次​。

​总之​，​计​科学院​的​党员​发展​总体​是​公平​的​，​因为​要​公示​，​即便​届时​心里​委屈​，​一个​一个​点名​公示​名单​下来​，​也​只能​发现​确实​没法​找茬​。​归根结底​是​名额​较​少​，​机会​要​争取​，​希望​有​理想​的​同学​从大一​开始​就​在​不​作弊​违纪​的​前提​下​，​把握​好​自己​的​考试​课​成绩​。

​其实​绝大多数​情况​下​，​入党​带不来​多少​功利​的​好处​，​更​多​的​是​责任​与​付出​。

docs.title: 保研​（​推免​）
docs.text: ​计算机​科学技术​学院​的​保研​工作​按照​学校​统一​的​ 《​青岛大学​推荐​优秀​应届​本科​毕业生​免试​攻读​研究生​工作​实施办法​》（​青大教字​〔2021〕21​号​） ​执行​，​每年​ 9 ​月​启动​。​政策​细则​（​基本​条件​、​综合​成绩​计算​、​综合​发展​素质​加分​等​）​见​ ​考试​与​成绩​ - ​保研​（​推免​）。​这里​结合​学院​的​实际​情况​，​给​你​说​点​文件​里​不会​明写​、​但​过来人​都​在意​的​东西​。

docs.title: 名额​与​竞争​态势
docs.text:
​学校​每年​把​推免​名额​下​到​学院​，​学院​再​按​专业​分​。​名额​不​按​固定​比例​给​，​而是​学院​依据​各​专业​毕业生​人数​、​培养​质量​等​统筹​分配​，​最后​名额​通常​落​在​ ​专业​总​人数​的​个位数​百分比​ ​附近​——​也​就是​大家​口口相传​的​"​前​ 5% ​左右​"。"​前​ 5% ​能​保研​"​这句​话​不算​错​，​但​它​描述​的​是​ ​最终​结果​，​而​不是​政策​标准​。​文件​里​的​真实​门槛​是​：

  • ​前​三年​考试​课​平均​成绩排名​ ​不​低于​专业​前​ 30%（​过​了​这线​才​有​申请​资格​）；
  • ​但​名额​就​那么​几个​，​所以​ ​真正​能​拿到​手​，​基本​要​看​你​在​专业​前​ 5% ​甚至​更​靠​前​的​位置​。

​换句话说​，​前​ 30% ​是​"​报名​资格​线​"，​前​ 5% ​左右​才​是​"​竞争​实线​"。​中间​那​ 25% ​的​同学​不是​不能​申请​，​而是​大​概率​陪​跑​——​这​不​叫​残酷​，​叫​现实​，​计算机​这​类​专业​本来​就​卷​。

docs.title: 对​计算机专业​，​尤其​要​抠​三点
docs.text:
1. ​成绩​是​命根子​，​加权​平均分​要​尽早​拉高​。

​综合​成绩​ = ​学业成绩​ × 90% + ​综合​发展​素质​ × 10%。​学业成绩​占​九成​，​这是​硬道理​。​计算机​课程​（​高数​、​线代​、​数据结构​、​操作系统​、​计算机网络​、​编译​原理​等​）​都​是​考试​课​，​全部​计入​加权​平均​。​大一​的​课少​、​单科​权重​却​大​，​是​拉开​差距​的​黄金​期​，​前​三年​每一分​都​在​为​四年​后​的​那份​排名​服务​。​别信​"​大学​60​分​万岁​"，​那​是​给​不​打算​保研​的​人​听​的​。

2. ​六级​是​隐形​门槛​，​别​拖​到​大三​。

​非​外语​专业​要求​ CET-6 ≥ 426 ​分​（​或​雅思​≥6/​托福​≥80）。​注意​是​六级​，​不是​四级​。​很多​实力​够​但​六级​没过​线​的​同学​，​最后​只能​眼睁睁​放弃​，​连​递补​的​机会​都​没有​。​建议​大二​把​六级​过​了​，​分数​够​ 426 ​即可​，​不用​追求​刷​高分​（​它​对​综合​成绩​没有​加成​）。​顺便​说​一句​：​六级​确实​可以​刷分​，​但​ 426 ​和​ 600 ​在​保研​这件​事上​待遇​一样​，​别​在​这​上面​花​冤枉​时间​。

3. ​挂科​=​直接​出局​，​没有​任何​商量余地​。

"​必修课​无不​及格​记录​"​是​硬​条件​。​哪怕​你​综合排名​专业​第一​，​只要​有​一门​必修课​不及格​，​就​直接​丧失​资格​。​所以​计算机​的​硬​课​（​尤其​是​数一​、​数据结构​这​类​容易​翻车​的​）​考前​务必​稳扎稳打​。

docs.title: 竞赛​与​科研​：​加​分​怎么​加​，​值不值得​卷
docs.text:
​综合​发展​素质​占​ 10%，​看着​不​多​，​但​在​专业​前​ 5% ​这个​神仙​打架​的​区间​，​一分​都​可能​决定​去留​。​对​计算机​学院​而言​，​最​相关​的​加​分项​是​这样​的​：

​项目​ ​折算​比例​ ​说明​ "​互联网​+" ​竞赛​ ​按​ 70% ​直接​累加​ ​国家级​金​/​银​/​铜奖​前​ 3 ​位​，100/80/60、80/60/40、60/40/20 ​分​ "​挑战杯​" ​按​ 20% ​国家级​金​/​银​/​铜奖​前​ 3 ​位​，​同​上​分档​ ​其他​权威​竞赛​（ACM、​程序设计​竞赛​等​） ​按​ 25% ​以​《​全国​普通高校​大学生​竞赛​排行榜​》​为​参考​，​排行榜​内​最高奖​ ≤50 ​分​，​未​上榜​ ≤40 ​分​ ​科研成果​（​论文​） ​按​ 25% ​需以​青岛大学​为​第一​单位​、​独立​或​第一​作者​；​赋分​标准​学院​自​定​

​学长​给​你​的​实话​：

  • "​互联网​+"​和​"​挑战杯​"​分值​高​，​但​拿到​国家级​奖项​的​难度​也​高​。​这​两个​赛​更​偏​"​文能​答辩​、​武能​拼团​"，​如果​你们​团队​没有​很能​打​的​老师​带队​，​普通人​很难​摸​到​国家级​奖杯​，​不用​把​它​当​主战场​。
  • ACM/​算法​类​竞赛​才​是​计科人​的​本命​赛道​。​学院​有​算法​协会​，​天梯​赛​、​蓝桥​杯​、ICPC/CCPC ​这​类​"​权威​竞赛​排行榜​"​上​的​赛项​，​拿个​国赛​奖​是​能​实打实​折算​进​ 25% ​那​一栏​的​。​但​注意​：​团队​赛​只有​前​ 3 ​位算​主力​队员​，​赋分​依次​递减​，​所以​要么​自己​当​队长​拿​位次​，​要么​确保​自己​排进​前​三​。
  • ​论文​加分​看​学院​细则​，​水刊​会​从严​。​文件​明确​"​对​社会​质疑​较​多​的​赛事​、​刊物​从严​把握​"，​而且​答辩​时​专家​会​重点​核查​是否​"​有名无实​"。​与其​花大​价钱​发水刊​，​不如​把​一篇​代表作​做实​——​代表作​评价​看​的​创新​质量​和​个人​贡献​，​不是​篇数​。

​特别​注意​答辩​要求​：​走​特殊​学术​专长​的​同学​必须​参加​公开​答辩​（​专家​≥5​人​、​副教授​以上​），​全程​录音​录像​、​结果​公示​。​没​通过​答辩​，​该项​成绩​直接​归零​。​同一天​同一​奖项​不要​重复​报​，​同一​成果​按​最高​等级​只算​一次​。

docs.title: 时间​线​：​想​保研​，​你​得​这样​走
docs.text:
• ​大​一大​二​：​把​考试​课​均分​拉​进​专业​前列​（​这​是​最​重要​的​）、​过​六级​、​加入​算法​协会​练​竞赛​
  • ​大三​上​：​继续​保​均分​，​可​开始​冲​ ACM/​蓝桥​杯​等​"​排行榜​"​竞赛​，​尝试​跟​老师​做​项目​、​攒​论文​
  • ​大​三下​：​确认​自己​排名​在​前​ 30% ​线内​，​评估​学院​历年​名额​；​竞赛​/​论文​开始​走​"​代表作​"​路线​
  • ​大四​ 9 ​月​：​关注​学院​发布​的​《​推免​工作​实施方案​》​和​当年​名额​，​填​《​申请表​》，​有​专长​还要​填​《​审核​鉴定​表​》​并​准备​答辩​
  • ​拿到​名额​后​：​在​教育部​系统​报名​，​自行​联系​接收​院校​，​在​截止​日期​前​拿到​接收单位​录取​资格​，​否则​视为​自动​放弃​

docs.title: 一句​话​总结
docs.text: ​计科院​保研​，​九分​靠​均分​，​一分​靠​竞赛​，​六级​和​零挂​科是​两条​红线​。​综合​成绩排名​决定​你​排​第几​，​排名​决定​你​拿​不​拿​得到​名额​——​就​这么​简单​。​别​指望​竞赛​逆天​改命​，​那​是​前​ 5% ​的​学霸们​决胜​的​加时赛​；​对​大多数​同学​来说​，​从大一​第一次​高数​考试​开始​认真对待​每​一场​考试​课​，​才​是​性价比​最高​、​也​最稳​的​保研​路径​。

docs.title: 就业
docs.text: ​计算机领域​方向​庞杂​、​知识​浩如烟海​，​每个​细分​方向​深挖​下去​都​学无止境​。​这里​把​常见​的​岗位​、​求职​的​思路​和​一些​过来人​的​忠告​整理​给​你​，​帮​你​在​职业​选择​上​少走弯路​。

docs.title: 常见​的​岗位​有​哪些
docs.text:
• ​前端​工程师​：​负责​界面​的​呈现​，​你​手机​ App ​里​的​每​一个​按钮​、​网页​上​的​每一处​样式​，​都​是​前端​的​成果​。​现已​被​Agent​干碎​
  • ​后​端​工程师​：​负责​业务​逻辑​与​数据​流转​，​你​发​一条​消息​，​要​经过​服务器​的​接收​、​存储​、​转发​，​才能​到达​对方​手机​，​这部分​工作​就是​后​端​
  • ​算法​工程师​：​负责​具体​算法​与​模型​的​设计​，​比如​根据​用户​的​历史​行为​决定​给​他​推​什么​内容​，​背后​就是​算法​在​起​作用​。
  • AI ​开发​ / Agent ​工程师​：​负责​大​模型​应用​开发​，​或者​基于​大​模型​的​ Agent ​进行​二次开发​，​模型​本质​是​接收​输入​、​推理​、​输出​结果​，Agent ​为​模型​提供​了​工具​调用​接口​和​工作​流​管理​。
  • ​网络安全​工程师​：​一个​很大​的​分类​，​可能​是​做​安全​服务​、​安全​研究​，​也​可能​是​车​联网​ / IoT / ​工控​方向​，​甚至​有些​地方​的​运维岗​也​叫​"​网络安全​工程师​"
  • ​渗透​测试​工程师​：​熟悉​攻防​技术​，​负责​应急​响应​和​漏洞​分析​，​通常​需要​有​竞赛​或​实战​经历​
  • ​安全​研究员​：​以​安全​研究​为​核心​，​方向​多种多样​
  • ​运维​工程师​：​产品​上线​后​难免​出​各种​问题​，​运维​就是​负责​让​系统​稳定​跑​起来​、​出​问题​及时处理​的​人​
  • ​产品​经理​：​负责​把​模糊​的​需求​翻译成​清晰​的​方案​，​先​和​客户​对齐​需求​、​设计​原型​，​再​交给​工程师​实现​

​以上​划分​只是​非常​粗​的​框架​，​建议​多去​ ​牛客​、BOSS ​直聘​ ​等​平台​翻翻​真实​岗位​的​招聘​要求​，​你​会​对​"​市场​需要​什么样​的​人​"​有​直观​的​认识​。

docs.title: 求职​这件​事​，​本质​上​是​三件​事
docs.text:
​第一​，​培养​终身​学习​的​能力​。 ​大学​阶段​最​重要​的​不是​背下​了​多少​知识​，​而是​是否​建立​了​"​快速​掌握​新​知识​"​的​能力​。​技术​在​日新月异​地​迭代​，​今天​流行​的​框架​明天​可能​就​过时​了​，​能​跟上​变化​的​人才​不至于​被​淘汰​。

​第二​，​攒足​项目​经历​。 ​国内​找​计算机​方向​的​工作​，​项目​经历​往往​是​重中之重​。​最​理想​的​状态​是​：​你​能​讲​出让​面试官​听得懂​、​觉得​你​厉害​、​且​方向​对口​的​项目​，​这三条​按​重要​程度​从​高到​低​排序​。​方向​对口​尤其​关键​——​校招​统一​面试​时​，​如果​你​的​经历​恰好​匹配​部门​的​用人​方向​，​被​捞起来​约​面试​的​概率​会大​很多​。​很多​人​的​第一份​实习​、​第一份​正式​ offer，​都​源于​一次​偶然​的​课堂​项目​或​老师​带​着​做​的​课题​，​然后​顺着​这个​方向​一路​滚雪球​。​所以​最好​从​一​开始​就​不要​将​就​：​本科毕业​打算​工作​，​就​尽早​确定​方向​、​尽早​动手做​项目​。

​第三​，​打牢​专业​基础​。 ​国内​大厂​基本​都​会​考察​基础知识​，​且​各有​侧重​，​这些​基础​课程​（​数据结构​、​操作系统​、​计算机网络​等​）​对​未来​的​职业生涯​有​潜移默化​的​影响​。​虽然​国内​的​本科​计算机教育​水平​参差不齐​，​但​自学能力​一定​不能​丢​。

docs.title: 关于​实习
docs.text:
​在校​招​之前​，​尽量​争取​做​一到​两份​实习​。​实习​不​只是​给​简历​镀金​，​更是​你​低成本​试错​、​验证​自己​适不​适合​某个​方向​的​机会​。​实习​的​次数​多​了​，​你​就​能​循序渐进​地​跳​到​更好​的​平台​，​和​更​厉害​的​同事​做​更​有​深度​的​项目​，​结识​的​人脉​和​看到​的​视野​也​随之​打开​。​对于​前​三四年​基本功​还​算​扎实​的​同学​，​大三​暑假​的​实习​会​是​补充​项目​经历​、​衔接​校招​的​大好机会​。

​别报​培训​机构​

​非常​不​推荐​报名​校外​或​网上​的​编程​培训​机构​。​互联网​上​高质量​的​免费​学习​资源​多到​看不完​（​慕课​、​官方​文档​、​开源​项目​、B ​站​课程​……），​培训​机构​的​课程​质量​参差不齐​，​收费​却​动辄​上万​，​性价比​极低​。​与其​花钱​报班​，​不如​把​省​下来​的​时间​花​在​动手​写​代码​上​。

docs.title: 零​基础​入门​计算机
docs.text:
​很多​同学​进计​科院​时​对​计算机​其实​是​"​不明​就​里​"​的​，​这​很​正常​。​下面​这份​清单​，​是​给​想​在​大​一​就​把​底子​打好​的​同学​的​入门​路线​，​都​是​从零开始​的​顺序​，​不用​有​压力​。

  • ​先​弄清楚​计算机​的​硬件​组成​和​作用​（CPU、​内存​、​硬盘​、​显卡​、​输入输出​设备​），​对​你​手里​的​电脑​有​最​基本​的​认识​
  • ​掌握​文件​管理​：​理解​文件​与​文件夹​、​绝对路径​ / ​相对路径​、​快捷方式​、​常用​快捷键​，​把​资源管理​器玩​明白​
  • ​感兴趣​的话​可以​研究​下​如何​自己​动手​组装​一台​电脑​，​装机​这件​事​既​能​练手​又​能​让​你​对​硬件​有​直观​理解​
  • ​用​ C/C++ ​作为​第一门​编程语言​入门​，Python ​可以​当​效率​工具​或​以后​ AI ​方向​的​基石​；​至于​未来​主攻​哪门​语言​（Java、Go、Rust、JavaScript……），​可以​根据​语言​特性​和​就业​方向​慢慢​抉择​
  • ​看一遍​ MIT ​的​经典​课程​《​计算机教育​中​缺失​的​一课​》，​它​能​帮​你​补齐​ shell、​编辑器​、Git ​这些​课堂​不教​但​极其​常用​的​工具​技能​
  • ​用心​学好​数据结构​与​算法​、​操作系统​、​计算机网络​这​几门​核心​课​，​更​体系化​的​学习​路线​可以​自己​上网​搜​，​发挥​主观​能动性​
  • ​学会​如何​提出​一个​好​问题​：​能​把​问题​描述​清楚​，​其实​已经​解决​了​一半​；​参考​ StackOverflow ​的​提问​方式​
  • ​加入​一两个​技术​社区​，​后期​可以​尝试​搭建​个人​博客​（​服务器​ / ​域名​ / ​图床​ / ​备案​……），​养成​用​输出​倒逼​输入​的​习惯​
  • ​尽早​想​清楚​未来​是​读研​还是​就业​，​它​很大​程度​上​决定​了​你​这​四年​的​重心​：
    • ​读研​：​尽早​找​一位​感兴趣​的​老师​，​跟进​他​的​课题​，​争取​做出​科研成果​，​对​未来​保研​ / ​考研​复试​都​是​加​分项​
    • ​就业​：​选​好​自己​的​技术​栈​，​多​做​项目​、​多​实习​

docs.title: 关于​自学
docs.text: ​计科​的​学习​，​自学能力​几乎​是​命脉​。​课堂​能​给​你​的​东西​有限​，​更​多​的​路​要​靠​自己​走​。

docs.title: 提升​自学能力​，​从​这​几件事​入手
docs.text:
• ​搜集​信息​：​搜索引擎​推荐​ Google ​或​ Bing，​别​把​大​模型​当成​唯一​的​答案​来源​，​培养​自己​动手​检索​的​习惯​
  • ​甄别​信息​：​学会​找​多​来源​交叉​印证​，​多​思考​、​多​和​别人​交流​，​再​不济​用大​模型​帮​你​汇总​
  • ​输出​倒逼​输入​：​多写​博客​，​把​学到​的​知识​用​自己​的话​讲​出来​，​往往​讲​着​讲​着​才​发现​哪里​没​懂​；​推荐​用​ Markdown ​写作​，​所见即​所得​
  • ​提升​英语​：​计算机领域​最​优质​的​一手​资料​几乎​都​是​英文​的​（​官方​文档​、​论文​、Stack Overflow……），​英语​好​意味着​你​能​直接​读​源头​，​而​不是​等​别人​嚼​过​的​博客​

docs.title: 自学​的​好处
docs.text:
• ​进度​自控​：​完全​按​自己​的​节奏​来​，​难​的​知识点​可以​反复​回看​视频​、​反复​ Google，​直到​彻底​弄懂​；​掌握​快​的​部分​则​两三倍​速​略过​，​不​浪费​一秒​
  • ​博采众长​：​计算机​的​几门​核心​课​（​体系结构​、​网络​、​操作系统​、​编译​原理​），​完全​可以​同时​看​不同​大学​的​课程​、​不同​教材​，​不同​侧重​能​极大丰富​你​的​视野​，​也​能​纠正​理解​上​的​偏差​
  • ​时间​自由​：​大学​的​课余时间​本​就​相对​自由​，​自学​让你能​更​灵活​地​安排​自己​的​时间​

docs.title: 自学​的​三个​坎
docs.text:
• ​交流​不便​：​对​着​屏幕​听​老师​讲课​，​遇到​没​听懂​的​点​没法​随时​打断​提问​。​解决​方式​是​独立思考​ + ​善用​搜索​，​最好​再​找​几个​志同道合​的​伙伴​一起​学​，​互相​答疑​
  • ​英文​门槛​：​国外​课程​从​视频​、​课件​到​作业​几乎​全是​英文​，​有​一定​的​门槛​。​但​这​也​恰恰​是​值得​花​力气​克服​的​挑战​，​毕竟​计算机领域​优质​资源​以​英文​居多​，​养成​英文​阅读​习惯​是​长期​受益​的​
  • ​自律​：​没有​ ddl ​有时候​真的​很​可怕​。​国外​的​很多​课程​相当​"​虐​"，​你​得​有​足够​的​驱动力​逼​自己​静下心来​啃​几十页​的​ project handout、​读上​千行​代码​框架​、​忍受​数​小时​的​ debug ​时光​——​没有​学分​、​没有​绩点​、​没有​老师​盯​着​，​支撑​你​的​只有​"​你​在​变强​"​这个​信念​

docs.title: 实用​ AI / Agent ​工具
docs.text:
​这​两年​ AI ​发展​极快​，​会​用​ AI ​基本​是​计​科学​生​的​必备​技能​了​。​国外​的​ GPT ​访问​不便​，​尽管​计算机​学生​应当​尽量​掌握​这种​“​技能​”，​这里​推荐​几个​国内​顺手​的​主流​工具​，​挑​适合​自己​的​用​即可​：

  • DeepSeek：​推理​能力​强​，​写​代码​、debug ​都​很​能​打​，​尤其​ token ​价格​，​梁圣​千古​。
  • ​通义​千问​：​阿里​系​，​功能​全面​，​国际​驰名​，​用​它​点​淘宝​闪购​外卖​再​优惠​几毛钱​，Qwen 3.7 ​已经​做到​国模​领先水平​
  • Kimi：​擅长​长​文本处理​，​适合​喂​文档​、​读​论文​，2026​年​年​中​的​K3​确实​Agent​使用​体验​感强​
  • ​秘塔​ AI ​搜索​：​带​来源​引用​的​ AI ​搜索​，​适合​查资料​，​读​论文​
  • ccswitch：​管理​ Agent ​的​供应商​、​路由​、​用量​、​会话​和​技能​。​如果​你​使用​中转站​或​为​ Agent ​接入​不​支持​的​模型​供应商​，​这个​会​非常​好用​。
  • OpenCode:​本​Wiki​的​首席​开发者​，​有​部分​低质量​免费​模型​可​供​体验​，​真心​建议​通过​b​站​视频​安装​体验​，​哪怕​用来​解包​游戏​
  • hermes：​当前​比较​优质​的​ Personal Assistant，​推荐​使用​ CLI，​当然​如果​习惯​ GUI，​还是​用​适合​自己​的​
  • Pi：​极简​、​轻量​，Agent ​二次开发​、​定制​化​与​学习​的​不二​选择​。
  • Oh My Pi：​基于​ Pi ​构建​的​ Agent ​框架​，​同样​轻量​，​提示​词​负担​轻​，​该​有​的​功能​都​有​，​没有​的​功能​用​插件​。
  • Codex：​无需​多言​，​最好​用​的​ Agent ​之一​。​有​ Desktop ​和​ CLI ​两种​选择​。
  • Claude Code：​无需​多言​，​最好​用​的​ Agent ​之一​。

​如果​你学​了​ Python，​还​可以​用​ Ollama ​在​本地​搭建​自己​的​ AI ​模型​，​既​练手​又​免费​，​还​挺​有意思​。

AI ​是​放大​你​能力​的​工具​，​不是​替代​你​思考​的​东西​。​用​它​加速​学习​没​问题​，​但​基础​的​知识​和​代码​能力​还是​要​自己​扎扎实实​练​。​不要​把​思考​外​包​。

docs.title: 推荐​书籍​与​学习​资源
docs.text:
​是不是​苦于​教材​晦涩​难懂​、​不知所云​？​别急​着​怀疑​自己​，​可能​只是​教材​写得​太烂​。​一本​好书​应当​是​把​作者​在​该​领域​深耕​多年​的​经验​融进​书里​，​告诉​你​"​为什么​"​以及​未来​该​"​怎么​做​"，​而​不是​炫技​式​的​理论​堆砌​。​下面​这份​书单​偏​系统​与​体系结构​方向​，​是​学有​余力​后​的​进阶​参考​：

  • 《​计算机​组成​与​设计​：​硬件​/​软件​接口​》—— ​体系结构​入门​经典​
  • 《​现代​操作系统​》—— ​操作系统​经典​教材​，​大黑​书​系列​能​啃得​动​就​已经​说明​天赋​了​
  • 《​计算机网络​：​自顶向下​方法​》—— ​计网​入门​必读​，​从​应用层​讲​起​，​好​懂​
  • 《​深入​理解​计算机系统​（CSAPP）》—— ​计算机系统​方向​的​圣经​，​建议​精读​
  • 《​编码​：​隐匿​在​计算机​软硬件​背后​的​语言​》—— ​从​继电器​讲​到​计算机​，​有趣​又​深刻​
  • 《​数据​密集型​应用​系统​设计​（DDIA）》—— ​分布式​与​大​数据​方向​的​必读​
  • 《​程序员​的​自我​修养​：​链接​、​装载​与​库​》—— ​国内​少有​的​优秀​系统​类书籍​
  • 《​高性能​ MySQL》 / 《MySQL ​必知​必会​》—— ​数据库​实践​入门​

​资源​汇总​：

  • Free Programming Books：​开源​编程​书籍​大全​
  • CSAPP ​配套​资源​：CMU ​官方​课程​主页​，​含​课件​和​ lab
  • OSTEP（Operating Systems: Three Easy Pieces）：​操作系统​免费​在线​教材​，​质量​极高​
  • OSTEP ​中文版​：​上面​那本​教材​的​中文版​
  • ​钝​悟​：​高质量​博客​，​覆盖面​极广​，​适合​面试​技能​补强​。
  • ​洛谷​：OI/ACM ​风格​的​算法​刷题​平台​
  • LeetCode：​就业​风格​的​算法​刷题​平台​，​除了​算法​还​包括​数据库​、Shell、​系统​设计​、Torch ​等​题目​

docs.title: 行业​观察​：​互联网​的​潮起潮落
docs.text:
​站​在​当下​的​时间​点​回望​，​互联网​行业​这​几年​的​变化​，​足以​给​所有​计科人​提个醒​。

2018-2020：​大厂​疯狂​扩张​，BAT ​非常​乐意​接收​本科生​，​会​一点​基础​算法​进​中小​厂​不难​，​签完​三方​还有​一笔​可观​的​签字​费​；

2020-2022：​互联网​仍​在​扩张期​，​新能源​、​智能​制造​类​企业​成为​毕业生​的​热门​选择​，​但​互联网​已经​隐约​出现​收缩​迹象​；

2022-2023：​互联网​大厂​开始​裁员​，​砍掉​没有​增量​的​业务​，​只​保留​营收​正常​、​有​前景​的​部分​，​行业​温度​骤降​；

2023-2025：​裁员​成为​常态​，​多家​知名​公司​解散​研发​基地​、​砍掉​边缘​业务​线​，​越来越​多​的​应届生​感受​到​"​寒冬​";

2026​上半年​：​因​Agent​的​高速​发展​与​推广​，​初级​的​前端​岗位​几乎​已经​全部​沦陷​，​大部分​公司​开始​前后​端​结合​的​模式​，​并且​形成​了​“​项目​不变​，​工作效率​高​了​，​加班​时间​没事​做​”​的​尴尬​局面​；

2026 ​之后​会​怎样​：​谁​也​无法​预测​。​但​有​一点​很​明确​——​当​大厂​把​重心​押注​在​尚未​真正​盈利​的​ AI ​大​模型​上​，​通过​"​快速​循环​"​方式​接收​和​裁撤​应届生​并非​不​可能​。​行业​的​容错​率​在​下降​，​选择​比​努力​更​重要​。

​这​不是​劝退​，​而是​提醒​：​把​命运​押​在​"​进​了​某家​公司​就​一劳永逸​"​上​，​是​最​危险​的​想法​。​真正​可靠​的​，​永远​是​持续​学习​的​能力​、​扎实​的​技术​功底​，​以及​不​把​鸡蛋​放在​同一个​篮子​里​的​清醒​。

docs.title: 大厂​还是​央​国企​ / ​体制​内
docs.text:
​个人​看法​，​见仁见智​。

​先看​经济账​：​如果​去​互联网​大厂​，​除非​能​起薪​一线​年入​ 45W ​上下​、​且​每​三年​有​像样​的​涨薪​，​才能​在​ 35 ​岁​前​攒​下​足够​的​积蓄​；​否则​，​二线​ 20W ​左右​的​半​垄断​型央​国企​反而​是​性价比​更​高​的​选择​——​稳定​、​压力​小​、​细水长流​。

​再​看​行业​现实​（​上限​）：​单纯​做​开发​，​少量​本校​毕业生​有​能力​前往​北京​上海​这些​一线​城市​的​应届​起薪​普遍​在​ 30-40W（​极少数​牛​人​），​达到​ 45W ​的​多数​是​算法​岗​（​大​模型​、NLP、CV ​等​），​而且​需要​一至​两篇​相关​领域​论文​ + ​一到​两家​大厂​实习​背书​。​本科​直接​ all in AI ​的​风险​很大​——​这个​方向​硕士​、​博士​一抓​一大​把​，​成果​和​学历​卡得​很​死​，​很多​硕士​毕业​最后​还是​转​了​开发​岗​。（​大部分​青大​本科​毕业生​留在​山东省​，​应届​月薪​不易​超过​1w，​切莫​望洋兴叹​，​亦​莫​止步​于​此​）

​央​国企​适合​谁​：​适合​希望​维持​稳定​生活​的​人​。​石油​、​发电​、​供电​、​烟草​、​通信​（​三大​运营商​）、​国有银行​、​交易所​等​半​垄断​型​单位​，​虽然​起薪​不如​大厂​，​但胜​在​稳定​、​细水长流​，​尤其​是​在​经济​下行​的​当下​，​不失为​一种​明智​选择​。

​几点​建议​：

  • ​如果​本科毕业​打算​工作​，​别​盲目​ all in ​热门​方向​，​先想​清楚​自己​适合​稳定​还是​适合​拼搏​
  • ​央​国企​校招​同样​看重​基础知识​和​项目​经历​，​别以为​进​了​国企​就​能​躺平​
  • ​无论​去​哪​，​实习​经历​都​是​加​分项​，​大三​暑假​的​实习​别错过​（​其实​大部分​同学​没有​去​实习​，​但​如果​不​打算​继续​深造​，​请​一定​要​争取​好​的​实习​机会​）

docs.title: 写​在​最后
docs.text:
​如果​你​能​在​三四年​里​建立​起​扎实​的​ C.S ​基础​，​有​相对​过硬​的​数学​功底​和​代码​能力​，​写过​不少​千行​级​的​ project，​掌握​至少​ C/C++/Java/Python ​等​两​三门​主流​语言​，​对​算法​、​操作系统​、​计算机网络​、​数据库​、Web ​开发​等​都​有​涉猎​——​那么​无论​选择​就业​还是​科研​，​你​都​会​有​相当​的​底气​。

​人​与​人​之间​真正​的​差距​，​往往​在于​判断力​，​而​判断力​来自​信息​差​。 ​多​搜集​信息​、​多​思考​、​多​试错​，​别怕​走弯路​——​人生​的​容错​率远​比​你​想象​的​高​。​不要​怂​，​也​不要​预设​某个​目标​是​终点​，​名校​不是​、​进​大厂​不是​、​保研​也​不是​。​保持​终身​学习​的​心态​，​找到​自己​真正​想​走​的​路​，​才​是​大学​四年​最​值得​的​投资​。

​说​这么​多​，​请​不要​被​所谓​的​“​高水平​收入​”​吓​到​，​认为​不​可能​，​或是​认为​自己​“​不配​”，​也​不要​因​所谓​的​“​到达​巅峰​前​必须​要​走​的​路​”​而​迷惘​，​认为​做​不到​，​或是​觉得​“​太过​遥远​”。​其实​上面​的​内容​并​不​适合​每​一个​人​，​只是​一个​参考​，​一个​美好​的​期盼​，​一个​我​见到​的​或许​我们​亦​能​企及​的​未来​，​我​也​见​过​每日​摆烂​的​同学​却​从未​挂科​，​毕业​季​找到​了​一份​自己​满意​的​工作​，​天天​在​骂​老板​和​享受​生活​的​流水线​中​感受​幸福​。​每个​人​都​有​属于​自己​的​追求​和​快乐​阈值​，​正如​我​在​另​一个​版块​送给​大家​的话​——​觉得​曾​快乐​过​，​就是​最好​的​结果​。

docs.text: ​如果​你​对​计算机​科学技术​学院​了解​更​多​，​或是​发现​应当​修改​的​内容​，​欢迎​通过​ GitHub ​仓库​ ​提交​补充​或​发起​ Pull Request。

docs.title: 专业​设置
docs.text: 专业​ ​说明​ ​机械工程​ ​就是​大家​印象​里​的​机械​ ​机械工程​创新​班​（​车辆​工程​方向​） ​其实​就是​机械​，​只不过​分​了​方向​叫​车辆​工程​，​和​上面​的​机械工程​只差​了​四个​专业课​不​一样​ ​智能​制造​工程​ ​原来​从​机械工程​里分​出来​的​，​学​的​和​机械工程​差别​稍大​一些​了​，​主要​差​在​专业课​上​ ​能源动力​与​工程​ ​大​二分​方向​，​应该​是​制冷​和​制热​两个​方向​ ​储能​科学​与​工程​ ​能动​里分​出来​的​，​原本​是​ ​测控​技术​与​仪器​ ​没​分​方向​，​就是​学​传感器​之类​的​ ​工业​设计​ ​有点​偏​美术​了​，​私​以为​偏​工业​方面​的​外观设计​多一些

docs.title: 校区​安排
docs.text:
​大一至​大四​均​在​浮山​住​

​我​这牢​东西​今天​才​知道​，​原来​大家​现在​只​需要​在​浮山​住​了​，​不​需要​从​金家​岭​再搬​浮山​了​，​真是​一个​时代​落幕​了​（​辛辛苦苦​写​了​好多​，​不想​删掉​所以​就​用​横线​划掉​了​嘿嘿​）

1️⃣​大一​金家​岭​，​大二​至​大四​浮山​：​机械工程​、​机械工程​创新​班​（​车辆​工程​）、​智能​制造​工程​、​能源​与​动力工程​、​储能​科学​与​工程​、​测控​技术​与​仪器​

2️⃣​大一至​大四​浮山​：​工业​设计​

docs.title: 学习
docs.text:
• ​最好​别挂科​！​不​好好学​无所谓​，60​分​万岁​也​很​好​！
  • ​每科​的​成绩​都​分为​平时​分​和​期末​分​，​两者​权重​每科​不​一定​，​有​的​55​开有​的​46​开​，​任课老师​会​在​第一次​上课​的​时候​告诉​你​占​比​分配​的​。
  • ​现在​学校​设立​了​考试​课​的​斩杀​线​，​为​期末考试​的​卷面​50​分​，​也就是说​期末​低于​50​的​直接​挂科​了​。
  • ​如果​真​不幸​挂科​了​，​不要​感觉​天塌​了​，​这​只是​小挂​，​下学期​开学​的​时候​还有​一次​免费​补考​机会​，​但是​这次​补考​只有​卷面​分​，​没有​平时​分​，​这​需要​你​在​假期​的​时候​好好​补习​一下​；​如果​再​没过​，​称为​大挂​，​只能​来​年​重修​了​（​比如说​大一上​的​课大挂​了​，​只能​大二​上​再​重新​跟着​新大一​的​一起​上​）

docs.title: 竞赛
docs.text:
​竞赛​参加​一下​挺​好​的​，​适当​参加​比赛​可以​让​你​的​大学​生活​没​这么​枯燥​，​充实​很多​。​个别​竞赛​有​奖金​，​还​能​"​公费旅游​"（​不是​全部​哈​！）

​学院​里​现在​主要​有​三个​竞赛​协会​：

  1. ​机器人​协会​：​学​stm32、51​单片机​之类​的​，​主要​研究​智能​小车​之类​的​实物​，​比如说​自主​寻路​灭火​小车​，​自主​取物​小车​之类​的​，​参加​的​比赛​有​中国​机器人​等​，​详情​可以​咨询​一下​协会​的​负责人​，​招生​是​在​大​一上​学期​
  2. ​创新​实践​协会​：​学​Solidworks，​简单​的​单片机​知识​，​也​是​做​实物​的​，​现在​主要​是​做​全国​大学生​机械​创新​设计​大赛​（​近几年​一直​偏​农机​方向​），​详情​咨询​负责人​吧​，​招生​也​是​大​一上​学期​
  3. ​三维​建模​协会​：​学​Solidworks、AutoCAD，​比赛​偏​技能​类​

docs.title: About the University
docs.text: Qingdao University is a key comprehensive university in Shandong Province and a "Double First-Class" construction university. Its history dates back to 1909 when the Qingdao Special Higher School was founded. In 1993, it was formed by merging four institutions: the former Qingdao University, Shandong Textile Engineering Institute, Qingdao Medical College, and Qingdao Normal College. The university now has 28 colleges and the Qingdao Medical School, 90 undergraduate programs, covering 11 discipline categories, with over 41,000 enrolled students and more than 500,000 notable alumni.

docs.title: About This Site
docs.text:
This site is maintained by all members of Baidu Tieba's QDU Bar and subsequent community supporters. It is an unofficial campus survival guide. It originally came from a Word document circulated in freshman groups, and through the word-of-mouth and continuous improvement of generation after generation of seniors, it gradually grew into what it is today — from New Student Guide to Campus Life, from Academics to Campus Services, covering every aspect of your life at QDU.

There are no cold official documents here, only heartfelt words from those who've been there. It doesn't make decisions for you, but only wishes to illuminate the bumps and stars on every path. If you find errors or have new experiences, you're welcome to contribute via the GitHub repository to help this guide continue growing.

"Virtue, Knowledge, Integrity, Innovation" — Qingdao University Motto

docs.title: How to Maintain This Section
docs.text:
This Wiki is built in the "Markdown files + configuration files" method, maintenance is very simple:

  • Add / Modify content: Directly create or edit .md files in the docs/ directory, no need to write any code

  • Update navigation: After a new page is created, just add a line in the nav of the root directory's mkdocs.yml, for example:

    - New Section:
  - New Page: new/page.md

  • Local deployment: After installing dependencies, execute mkdocs serve for local preview. For specific steps, see "Local Deployment" below

Maintenance principle: Pages only store text and links, data should be stored externally as much as possible, so the Wiki will always remain lightweight and easy to maintain.

docs.title: Local Deployment
docs.text:
To preview or modify the Wiki on your local machine, you need to install dependencies first (requires Python to be installed):

pip install mkdocs-material mkdocs-git-revision-date-localized-plugin mkdocs-git-committers-plugin

Then start local preview in the project root directory:

mkdocs serve

Open http://127.0.0.1:8000 in a browser to preview; the page will automatically refresh after modifying files.

Tip

  • The above command installs the minimum dependencies required for local preview, consistent with online build (GitHub Actions)
  • If the command is not found, add Python's Scripts directory to the system PATH, or use python -m mkdocs serve instead
  • When port 8000 is occupied, you can specify another port: mkdocs serve -a 127.0.0.1:8123

docs.title: College Overview
docs.text:
The College of Chemistry and Chemical Engineering of Qingdao University originated from the former Applied Chemistry major of Qingdao University, the former Fine Chemical Engineering major of Shandong Textile Engineering Institute, and the former Chemistry Teacher Education major of Qingdao Normal College. The college upholds the spirit of "Seeking Truth, Innovation, Integration, and Striving," cultivating over ten thousand outstanding talents working in education, research, industry, commerce, and government agencies, with talent cultivation quality, teaching and research level, and social service ability ranking among the top in the university.

The college offers three undergraduate majors: Applied Chemistry, Chemical Engineering and Technology, and Chemistry Teacher Education. Applied Chemistry was selected as one of the first batch of national first-class undergraduate major construction sites, Chemical Engineering and Technology passed the national engineering education professional certification and was selected as a provincial first-class undergraduate major construction site; Chemistry Teacher Education has successfully passed the second-level certification for teacher education majors by the Ministry of Education. The college has a first-level discipline doctoral program in Chemistry, two first-level discipline master's programs in Chemistry and Chemical Engineering and Technology, and two second-level discipline professional master's programs in Chemical Engineering and Subject Teaching (Chemistry). In 2016, Chemistry entered the ESI global top 1% and was selected as a key construction first-class discipline in Shandong Province. In 2025, it entered the ESI global top 1‰, with discipline strength continuing to rise.

The college currently has over 120 faculty and staff, including 37 professors, 59 associate senior titles, over 95% holding doctoral degrees, and over 50% having overseas study and work experience. Among full-time teachers, there is 1 chief professor, 2 National Outstanding Youth, 2 Shandong Province Taishan Scholars, 14 Shandong Province Young Taishan Scholars, 2 Shandong Province Outstanding Youth, 9 Shandong Province Excellent Youth, and 6 Shandong Province Youth Innovation Teams.

The college actively promotes the strategy of revitalizing the college through research, adheres to connotative high-quality development, and has strong research capabilities. It has provincial-level teaching and research platforms such as the Shandong Provincial Key Laboratory of Intelligent Molecular Science and Engineering, the Shandong Provincial Collaborative Innovation Center for Key Hydrogen Energy Materials and Technology in Universities, the Shandong Provincial Key Laboratory of Functional Molecules and Materials in Universities, the Shandong Provincial Sino-Japan Carbon Nanomaterials Cooperative Research Center, and the Shandong Provincial Demonstration Center for Chemistry Experiment Teaching in Higher Education Institutions, as well as municipal-level platforms such as the Qingdao Municipal Key Laboratory of Molecular Manufacturing and Precision Health, the Qingdao Municipal Technology Innovation Center for Optoelectronic Biosensing and Its Clinical Diagnosis and Treatment Applications, the Qingdao Municipal Technology Innovation Center for Green Hydrogen Energy Materials and Equipment, the Qingdao Municipal Engineering Research Center for Surface and Interface Analysis and Measurement Technology, and the Qingdao Municipal Engineering Technology Research Center for Comprehensive Utilization of Marine Bromine Resources. In the past five years, the college has published over 1,000 high-level SCI research papers, undertaken over 50 National Natural Science Foundation projects and over 100 provincial and ministerial projects, authorized over 120 national invention patents, and received over 90 million yuan in various project funding; it has won 3 Shandong Provincial Natural Science Second Awards, 1 Shandong Provincial Youth Science and Technology Award, and other honors. It has established long-term connections with well-known universities and research institutions at home and abroad, including in the United States, Germany, and Japan, and has established long-term cooperative relationships with dozens of enterprises domestically and internationally.

The college always adheres to the training philosophy of "student-oriented," strengthening "one-two-three-four-five" collaborative education, with remarkable results in talent cultivation. Currently, there are over 930 full-time undergraduate students and over 470 master's students; the undergraduate further study rate has exceeded 50% for consecutive years, the master's further study rate exceeds 30%, and over 70% of students are admitted to 985, 211, and double first-class universities for further studies. The college implements a "innovation + practice" dual-mentor talent training model, winning over 30 first and second prizes in the China International College Students' Innovation Competition, the "Challenge Cup" National College Students' Extracurricular Academic Science and Technology Works Competition, and various national and provincial chemistry, chemical engineering, and teacher education competitions. Graduates mostly engage in scientific research, technology development, production, and business management in domestic well-known universities, research institutes, enterprises, and public institutions.

The college adheres to the educational model of "ideological and political guidance promotes character development, and academic atmosphere construction promotes talent formation," with party building work fully supporting student growth. The "Chemistry Department Party Branch" won the first batch of national party building demonstration branches, and the "Student First Party Branch" won the fourth batch of national party building demonstration branches; in addition, the college has successively been approved as a Shandong Provincial party building demonstration branch, an advanced grassroots party organization in the Shandong Provincial education system, and a "dual leader" teacher party branch secretary studio in Shandong Province universities. The Qingdao University Flag Guard, formed primarily with outstanding students from our college, has gone through nearly 30 years of hardships and has become a banner of patriotic education at Qingdao University, winning the Shandong Provincial "College Student Ideological and Political Work Innovation Award" and Qingdao City "Top Ten Youth Volunteer Service Collectives." The college has successively won honorary titles such as Qingdao University "Advanced Student Work Unit," "May Fourth Red Flag Youth League Committee (General Branch)," and "Advanced Graduate Employment Unit" for many consecutive years.

(Data as of May 2026)

docs.title: Party Membership
docs.text:
For the full process, see Party Membership. Briefly for our college: Good grades, good grades, good grades. Exam course ranking in top 50% is mandatory; the higher the better. Even if you're a class officer, student council member, or close with teachers, poor grades will definitely prevent "priority development" — you'll have to wait until senior year.

Party membership quota ratios are generally higher for undergraduates than graduates, based on the college's overall indicators. Generally, fewer quotas are given to juniors, with more for​即将​毕业​的​ seniors. For CS and Software Engineering, the same major gets fewer than 10 development quotas per semester for juniors, roughly averaging within 10% of the major's students having the opportunity to become full members. Including probationary members, this ratio reaches about 15%.

To develop early and become a full member before graduation, you need to simultaneously meet "excellent academic performance" and "cadre experience + substantial volunteer service hours" — missing either means waiting until senior year. There's also a possibility of excellent students getting a development opportunity in spring of junior year to boost their postgraduate recommendation applications, but priority goes to those with cadre experience.

The CS college's activist exam content is only the Party Constitution, and the development target training exam has similar reference content and format. Grading is strict, with about one-third of students failing each year, having to wait another semester.

Failing a course (not passing even the retake) means no development consideration within four years of undergraduate study, unless pursuing graduate studies at the same university. Failing a course (passing the retake) won't disqualify you, but will affect your ranking.

Overall, the CS college's Party development is fair due to public disclosure. Even if you feel aggrieved, seeing the public list name by name leaves no room for complaints. Quotas are limited — opportunities must be pursued. Aspiring students should maintain good exam grades from freshman year without cheating or violations.

In most cases, Party membership doesn't bring much utilitarian benefit — it's more about responsibility and dedication.

docs.title: Postgraduate Recommendation
docs.text: The CS college's postgraduate recommendation follows the university's unified regulations, starting annually in September. Policy details (basic requirements, comprehensive score calculation, development quality bonuses) see Exams & Grades - Postgraduate Recommendation. Here's what the documents won't explicitly say but experienced students care about:

docs.title: Quotas and Competition
docs.text:
The university allocates quotas to colleges, then colleges distribute by major. Quotas are not fixed percentages but based on graduate numbers and training quality, typically falling in the single-digit percentage of total major enrollment — what everyone calls "top 5% or so." "Top 5% for recommendation" isn't wrong, but it describes the final result, not the policy standard. The real thresholds in the documents are:

  • First three years exam course average ranking not below top 30% (minimum for application eligibility);
  • But quotas are limited, so actually getting it basically requires being in the top 5% or higher.

In other words, top 30% is the "application line," top 5% is the "competition line." The middle 25% can apply but will likely be spectators — that's not cruelty, it's reality. CS is inherently competitive.

docs.title: For CS Students, Focus on Three Points
docs.text:
1. Grades are life itself — raise your weighted average as early as possible.

Comprehensive score = Academic score × 90% + Development quality × 10%. Academic score counts 90% — that's the hard truth. CS courses (calculus, linear algebra, data structures, OS, networks, compilers) are all exam courses counted in the weighted average. Freshman year has few courses but high individual weight — it's the golden period to pull ahead. Every point in the first three years serves that final ranking. Don't believe "60 points is enough in college" — that's for those not aiming for recommendation.

2. CET-6 is a hidden threshold — don't delay until junior year.

Non-foreign language majors require CET-6 ≥ 426 (or IELTS≥6/TOEFL≥80). Note: it's CET-6, not CET-4. Many capable students who didn't pass CET-6 have to give up with no backup chance. Recommend passing CET-6 in sophomore year; 426 is enough — no need for high scores (no bonus to comprehensive score). By the way, CET-6 can be retaken for higher scores, but 426 and 600 are treated the same for recommendation — don't waste time on this.

3. Failing a course = immediate disqualification, no negotiation.

"No failing grades in required courses" is absolute. Even if ranked first overall, one failing required course means immediate disqualification. So for CS's tough courses (especially Calculus I, Data Structures), prepare thoroughly before exams.

docs.title: Competitions & Research: How Bonuses Work
docs.text:
Comprehensive development quality counts 10% — seems small, but in the top 5% bracket where top students compete, a single point can determine your fate. For CS students, the most relevant bonus items are:

Item Conversion Description "Internet+" Competition 70% direct addition National gold/silver/bronze top 3: 100/80/60, 80/60/40, 60/40/20 "Challenge Cup" 20% National gold/silver/bronze top 3, same scoring Academic papers 25% Papers must be published with QDU as first author unit Special academic expertise defense Required for special talents Public defense with panel of 5+ experts

docs.title: Study
docs.text:
• It's best not to fail courses! It's okay not to study hard; 60 points is great!
  • Each subject's grade is divided into regular scores and final exam scores, with varying weights for each subject. Some are 50-50, some are 40-60. The teacher will tell you the weight distribution in the first class.
  • The school has now set a threshold for exam courses, which is 50 points on the final exam paper. This means if you score below 50 on the final, you directly fail.
  • If you unfortunately fail, don't feel like the sky is falling. This is just a minor failure. There is still a free make-up exam opportunity at the beginning of next semester, but this make-up exam only has paper scores, no regular scores. You need to study hard during the holidays. If you fail again, it's called a major failure, and you can only retake the course next year (for example, if you fail a freshman first semester course, you can only retake it with the new freshmen in sophomore first semester).

docs.title: Competitions
docs.text:
Participating in competitions is quite good; appropriate participation can make your university life less boring and more fulfilling. Some competitions have prize money and can even be "government-funded travel" (not all!)

Recruitment is in freshman first semester.
  2. Innovation Practice Association: Learning SolidWorks, simple microcontroller knowledge, also making physical objects. Currently mainly focusing on the National College Students Mechanical Innovation Design Competition (in recent years it has been biased towards agricultural machinery direction). Consult the person in charge for details. Recruitment is also in freshman first semester.
  3. 3D Modeling Association: Learning SolidWorks, AutoCAD, competitions are skill-oriented

docs.title: Fun Event Rules (Key Introduction)
docs.text:
These are the events with the most laughter throughout, intense competitors beware, participation is what matters:

  • Penguin Walk Relay: Teams of 6 (3 men, 3 women), three volleyballs held between legs and arms, run around markers at 20 meters and return; if ball drops, pick up and continue
  • Ball Balancing Relay: Teams of 8 (4 men, 4 women), balance a softball on a badminton racket with one hand; ball cannot touch ground or be touched by hand; 40-meter course (return at 20 meters)
  • Rock Crossing: Stand on three "river rocks" and move forward alternately; 15-meter course; body cannot touch anything other than rocks
  • Plank Jump Face-to-Face Relay: Teams of 10 (5 men, 5 women), hold plank between knees and jump forward; 30-meter face-to-face relay; if plank drops, re-secure before continuing
  • Face-to-Face Relay: Single leg men 100m, women 60m; each team 20 people divided into two groups of 10 at each end; baton exchange must be behind end line; dropped baton must be picked up by the passer

  • Participating units must purchase personal accident insurance for athletes

Never Do These

Impersonators will have both the impersonated and impersonator disqualified, and the team's total score and "Spiritual Civilization Unit" eligibility cancelled; unjustified withdrawal also cancels the unit's "Spiritual Civilization Unit" eligibility.

docs.title: Opening Ceremony
docs.text:
The opening ceremony is held at 7:30 AM on the first day; athletes, referees, and spectators from all units must gather by 7:00 AM.

Opening ceremony program approximately:

  1. Athletes enter (order: national flag team, university flag team, colorful flag team, bouquet team, athlete teams)
  2. Introduction of attending leaders and guests
  3. University leader declares sports meet open
  4. Raise national flag, play and sing national anthem
  5. Raise university flag, sing university anthem
  6. University leader delivers opening speech
  7. Athlete representative oath, referee representative oath
  8. Athletes exit
  9. Baduanjin, aerobics performance
  10. Competition begins

docs.title: Spiritual Civilization Unit Evaluation
docs.text:
The sports meet also selects "Spiritual Civilization Units," mainly based on:

  • Timely entry and exit, neat formation, distinctive spectator area arrangement
  • High spectator attendance, no tardiness or early departure, good spirit
  • Organizing cheerleaders to cheer for athletes
  • Active submission of manuscripts, promoting good deeds
  • Environmental protection, no fruit peels or paper scraps when leaving

Disqualification for: Deliberately contradicting, insulting referees and staff; fighting or other serious interference with sports meet order; falsification, impersonation, or other violations of sports ethics.

docs.title: Tips
docs.text:
• Two days of competition are basically full-day; students without competition events generally watch as spectators in designated areas (cannot walk freely in competition venues)
  • May in Qingdao has strong midday UV; as spectators, remember to bring water, sunscreen, cushion/small stool as needed
  • Students wanting to participate should watch for college physical education department registration notices; per person limit 2 events, popular events have limited spots; act fast
  • Faculty events like rolling ball target hit and softball throw accuracy are fun; worth watching when passing by

This article is compiled from the 2023 sports meet competition regulations and schedule; specific events, times, and registration methods are subject to the university's notifications of that year.

docs.title: Campus Overview
docs.text:
Qingdao University covers an area of 2,496 mu with over 41,000 full-time students. In 2025, the university invested heavily to complete the installation of 7,566 air conditioners, achieving full coverage of air conditioning in student dormitories! This is a huge change; from now on, QDU dormitories say goodbye to the era without air conditioning. Meanwhile, the new student dormitory project on Fushan Campus (Buildings A, B, C, expected to provide about 4,847 beds) has started construction, with a construction period from June 2025 to 2027, when living conditions will further improve.

Loyalty Declaration of Dormitory Air Conditioning

The great air conditioner has descended upon its loyal QDU.

docs.title: General Information
docs.text:
• Air Conditioning: Since 2025, all dormitories have air conditioners installed, achieving full air conditioning coverage in student dormitories!
  • Heating: All dormitories are equipped with heating; Qingdao winters are cold but indoor temperatures are warm.
  • Electricity: Dormitories have 24-hour power supply, voltage 220V. High-power appliances are strictly prohibited (hair dryers, curling irons, electric cooking pots, and other heating appliances cannot be used; they will cause power cuts, requiring processing at the college and dormitory management office to restore power).
  • Internet: Campus network (QDU-1X and QDU-Web) requires internet service registration. Dormitories can have wired connections (consult customer service for details). Campus network is free for the first month, then requires payment. Account is student ID, password is last ten digits of ID card.
  • Bed Assignment: Dormitories and beds are randomly assigned before student registration, with a notice posted on the door. For special needs (too tall, overweight, mobility difficulties, etc.), contact your counselor at registration for adjustment.
  • Curfew: Dormitories have curfew; generally, you must return before 11:30 PM, otherwise you may not be able to enter. Entry and exit require swiping campus card.
  • Room Checks: No teacher checks at night, but students (class committee members) will check dormitory headcount.
  • Dormitory Inspections: Freshman management is relatively strict; maintain cleanliness, with daily duty for trash disposal and sweeping.
  • Bedding: The mattress dimensions provided by the university (optional order) are 1.9*0.95 (m) for reference.

docs.title: Dormitory Dimensions and Configuration
docs.text:
• Bed Dimensions: 90cm × 190cm (can apply for extension if length is insufficient)
  • Cabinets: Usually one per person, some dormitories have multiple per person. Space approximately 100cm×100cm×100cm, no dividers (can be purchased separately)
  • Ladder: Square iron rod
  • Floor: Varies by dormitory building, cement or tile; floor mats can be placed but are difficult to maintain
  • Sockets: Available beside each bed, but limited to low-power uses like charging

docs.title: Dormitory Management
docs.text:
Q: What time do dormitory lights go out? Is there a curfew? A: Dormitories do not have lights out, you can stay up late. But there is curfew, generally must return before 11:30 PM, otherwise you cannot enter. Different dormitory managers have different requirements. Swiping campus card is required for entry and exit at any time.

Q: Can I stay in the dormitory when there are no classes? Can I enter the dormitory at any time? A: Yes, you can stay in the dormitory when there are no classes. But pay attention to curfew time.

Q: Are dormitory inspections strict? A: Freshman year is relatively strict; maintain cleanliness, bed curtains are not allowed. Daily duty for trash disposal and sweeping. Dormitory sockets except for charging cannot be used for other appliances (power limited).

Q: Can I put pillows or similar items on the bed? A: Yes, but it's best to put them away during hygiene inspections.

Q: Is the dormitory floor cement? Can I put floor stickers? A: Varies by dormitory building; you can but the effect is not great.

Q: Can I keep pets in the dormitory? A: No, the university prohibits keeping pets in dormitories.

docs.title: Bedding
docs.text:
Q: What are the bed dimensions? A: Standard dimensions are 90cm × 190cm. If the bed length is insufficient, you can apply for an extension.

Q: How is the university bedding? Is it recommended to use the university's? A: The university bedding quality is acceptable for normal use. Can be purchased as a set (ordering guide included with admission notice) or brought from home. If you don't want to carry heavy luggage at the start of school, you can directly use the university's.

Q: Can I buy bedding items individually? A: Only set purchase or full set from home is supported; individual purchase is not available.

Q: Must I use the university's unified bedding for military training? A: Not necessarily; you can use your own. Following university dimensions makes tidying up easier, but not following dimensions is also fine as long as you keep it tidy.

docs.title: Storage and Decoration
docs.text:
Q: How big are the dormitory cabinets? Do they have dividers? A: Cabinet space is approximately 100cm×100cm×100cm, one per person (some dormitories have multiple per person), no dividers; storage supplies can be purchased separately. Wardrobes and storage cabinets are not separate.

Q: Are there sockets beside each bed? A: Yes, but power is limited, only for low-power devices like phones and computers.

Q: Can I put things on the dormitory walls? Can I put up wallpaper? A: You can stick adhesive hooks (be careful not to damage the walls) and hang posters. For wallpaper, consult your counselor after school starts.

Q: Can I put floor mats in the dormitory? A: Not recommended; although possible, they are difficult to maintain.

Q: Can I bring large storage boxes? A: Very large storage boxes are not recommended; you can buy them later based on available space. Items can only be placed in and on top of cabinets.

Q: Are the dormitory ladders round or square? A: Square; you'll see when school starts.

docs.title: Appliances and Equipment
docs.text:
Q: Do dormitories have air conditioning? A: Since 2025, all dormitories have air conditioners installed, achieving full air conditioning coverage! Say goodbye to summers without air conditioning.

Q: Do dormitories have heating? A: All are equipped with heating; indoor temperatures are warm during Qingdao winters.

Q: Are hair dryers allowed in dormitories? A: Hair dryers are strictly prohibited in dormitories (they are high-power heating appliances that will cause power cuts). After a power cut, you must go to the college and dormitory management office for processing to restore power. You can use your own hair dryer in public areas downstairs (sockets available). Bathhouses have scan-to-use hair dryers.

Q: Can I bring a curling iron? A: Curling irons and other heating appliances are strictly prohibited in dormitories.

Q: Do dormitories have drinking water dispensers? A: Generally equipped with public drinking water dispensers; self-payment for water is required, using the "Duocai Campus" APP.

Q: Do dormitories have washing machines? A: Public washing machines are available in dormitory buildings; bring your own laundry detergent.

Q: Are power strips provided in dormitories? A: The university does not provide power strips; you need to purchase them yourself, one socket per person.

Q: Do dormitories have trash cans, brooms, and mops? A: Dormitories are equipped with basic cleaning tools; if not available, you can pick them up at designated locations; no need to bring your own.

Q: Do dormitories have WiFi? How do I get campus network? A: After registering for campus network, you can connect to the university WiFi via account and password. Register through the "Jingcai Campus" official account. Campus network is free for the first month, then requires payment. Account is student ID, password is last ten digits of ID card.

docs.title: Other
docs.text:
Q: Can I eat in the dormitory? A: You can bring food back to eat, but cannot cook yourself.

Q: Does the dormitory support charging electric vehicles? A: Jinjialing Campus has many steps and slopes; bicycles are not recommended. There are no dedicated electric vehicle parking or charging areas. Bringing batteries into dormitories is not only against regulations, but after the class of 2023 graduates, there should be no legal electric vehicles left; only on-campus shared electric vehicles can be used.

Q: Can I arrive early and stay in the dormitory? A: No, you must register according to the university's unified orientation schedule; dormitories are assigned on registration day.

Q: Can I see photos after dormitory assignment? Are beds arranged by the university? A: Dormitory information is notified by the class monitor on orientation day. Beds are arranged by the university in advance. For exchanges, negotiate internally and then contact your counselor.

Q: Do dormitories have study rooms? A: Some dormitory buildings are equipped with study rooms (see specific building notes above); additionally, you can use empty classrooms in teaching buildings and the library for studying.

Q: Can I put things under the dormitory bed? A: Yes, but keep it clean and tidy.

Q: Are there hooks in the dormitory to hang clothes? A: Adhesive hooks are allowed on dormitory walls for hanging clothes (be careful not to damage the walls).

Q: Do I need to bring a thermos? A: Depends on personal situation; available at university stores, or you can bring your own.

Q: What's the difference between bed curtains and mosquito nets? A: Jinjialing Campus does not allow bed curtains, but mosquito nets are allowed.

Q: Can I install a bed desk? A: The university has not explicitly prohibited it; you can install one based on your situation.

Q: Where can I air my quilt? A: You can air your quilt on the balcony or downstairs railing.

docs.text:
To be updated

Some information on this page may be outdated or unverified. Contributions via GitHub are welcome.

Qingdao University currently has over 41,000 full-time students and covers an area of 2,496 mu, with numerous dining halls across multiple campuses. According to the university's Logistics Management Office, there are currently 21 dining halls on all campuses, including 12 basic meal halls and 9 flavor halls. In recent years, the university has been promoting the "Open Kitchen" project renovation, continuously improving the hygiene and safety standards of dining halls.

docs.title: Jinjialing Campus
docs.text: Jinjialing Campus has five main dining halls distributed across the East and West campuses, plus an underground passage food area.

docs.title: Dining Hall 1 (Waterfront Restaurant)
docs.text:
Location: West Campus, named "Waterfront Restaurant" due to its proximity to Jian Lake, with excellent scenery. Three floors.

  • First Floor: Mixed dishes, set meals. Breakfast options are limited; suitable for lunch and dinner. Also offers instant noodles, malatang, egg-wrapped rice. There is a 7-Eleven store at the entrance of Dining Hall 1's first floor, which also sells bento and rice meals.
  • Second Floor: Self-service model, choose dishes yourself and pay collectively based on each dish's price. Suitable for breakfast, lunch is average.
  • Third Floor: Has a halal window upon entry. Mixed dish windows offer many varieties, being the birthplace of QDU's "dark cuisine" (creative dishes like fruit stir-fried with meat). There is also a "Lemon Not Cute" window offering various snacks and cakes, with stylish tables and chairs in the small shop.

docs.title: Dining Hall 2 (Flavor Restaurant)
docs.text:
Location: West Campus, in front of Jian Lake.

Wide variety, clean environment, higher prices but delicious. Juices are freshly squeezed, and there is the only fried yogurt shop near QDU. Breakfast is also quite rich.

docs.title: Dining Hall 3 (Faculty and Staff Restaurant)
docs.text:
Location: West Campus.

Primarily open to faculty and staff, but students can also go. Food quality is relatively stable. Breakfast includes 3 yuan/onion beef buns, which are very cost-effective.

docs.title: Dining Hall 4 (Including Chinese Fast Food)
docs.text:
Location: East Campus.

  • Second Floor: Bucket rice, grilled meat rice, steamed buns, pies, various noodles, Lanzhou hand-pulled noodles, malatang (very cheap), mixed dishes (slightly expensive, calculated per serving), dumplings, wontons; rice can be ordered in half portions.
  • Third Floor: Chinese fast food, rice with toppings, mixed dishes.

docs.title: University of Science and Technology South Campus Restaurant
docs.text:
Location: Adjacent to Qingdao University of Science and Technology's South Campus, next to QDU Jinjialing Campus.

Delicious and affordable, recognized as the best dining hall on the East Campus. However, you need a friend from UST to take you in. The underground passage allows takeout and offers delivery services.

docs.title: East-West Campus Underground Passage
docs.text: The underground corridor between East and West campuses is similar to a snack street, with eight to nine windows and fruit sales. You can order on-campus or off-campus delivery via Meituan or Ele.me, usually with a one-yuan delivery fee or free.

docs.title: Fushan Campus
docs.text: Fushan Campus is divided into East, West, and North campuses, with over ten dining halls.

docs.title: Hongyuan Dining Hall
docs.text: Breakfast: fried dough sticks, eggs, scallion oil pancakes, bread, steamed rolls, pickles (frequently updated). Lunch and dinner are mixed dishes, plus boiled noodles, fried rice, fried noodles, etc. This dining hall has a staff member who handles lost clothes; you can give him suggestions (like adding more food varieties). The classification is clear and bright.

docs.title: Yingyuan Dining Hall (First Floor)
docs.text: Affordable prices, with malatang, noodles, self-set meals, instant noodles, clay pot, fried rice, fried noodles, steamed buns, etc.

docs.title: Flavor Restaurant (Second Floor)
docs.text:
Appears to be the best-tasting restaurant in Fushan Campus, with wide variety and slightly higher prices. Offers:

  • Northwestern flavors, rice bowls, sizzling iron plate rice, grilled meat rice, pizza
  • Guangdong flavors, Hunan flavors
  • Malatang, clay pot soup, spicy hot pot, Chongqing small noodles
  • Various flatbreads, steamed buns, porridge

There is also a 7-Eleven store on the second floor; bento and oden are delicious.

docs.title: Halal Restaurant
docs.text: Many specialty dishes, affordable, hygienic, with frequent free soup. Hand-pulled noodles and sliced noodles taste good. In summer, there are also cold noodles and dumplings.

docs.title: Cultural Celebrity Restaurant
docs.text:
• First Floor: One window for oil-splashed noodles, other windows serve mixed dishes, cheap.
  • Second Floor: Has clay pot that was once featured in newspapers, with multiple flavors. Noodles are cheap and affordable. Various steamed buns, mantou, flatbreads.

docs.title: Renyuan Dining Hall (2023 Shandong Province University Star-rated Dining Hall)
docs.text:
Very down-to-earth, lunch and dinner dishes are very cheap. Former President Xia Dongwei used to frequent here.

  • Breakfast: fried dough sticks, pickles, etc.
  • Lunch/Dinner: beef rice noodles (with sour cabbage), mixed dishes.

docs.title: Zhongkuai Restaurant (Next to International Restaurant)
docs.text:
Slightly expensive, wide variety, good taste. Occasionally closed on weekends.

  • First Floor: Seaweed egg soup, soup dumplings, dumplings, clay pot soup (egg custard, mushroom chicken soup, kelp pork ribs), hand-pulled noodles (highly praised), malatang.
  • Second Floor: Self-selected dishes, relatively affordable, delicious.

docs.title: International Restaurant
docs.text: First-floor Western restaurant, beautiful environment, offers coffee and steak, frequently visited by foreign friends, slightly higher prices.

docs.title: Liuyuan Dining Hall
docs.text:
Two floors with staggered rest schedules.

  • Breakfast: Egg fried rice, egg pancake, fried mantou slices, sugar pancake, fried dough sticks, pies, eggs, braised eggs, fried eggs, various pickles, cold dishes, noodles, soy milk, mixed congee.
  • Lunch/Dinner: Mixed dishes, noodles, sweet potato and corn (seasonal), various mantou (corn, white flour, red sweet potato), steamed buns, purple rice, etc.

docs.title: Liuyuan Flavor Restaurant
docs.text:
Dumplings, wontons, noodle dishes, rice bowls, wraps, side dishes, malatang, clay pot soup, oil-splashed noodles.

Additionally, behind Building C there is "Laiba Fruit Shop" selling fruit, instant noodles, etc.; "Yizhiwei Leisure Bar" offers pies, eggs, rice bowls, etc. for breakfast.

docs.title: Around Jinjialing Campus
docs.text:
• East-West Campus Junction (Off-Campus): "Ditch Oil Street" (very short), with restaurants, milk tea shops, stores, barbershops, cosmetic shops, eyeglass shops.
  • "San Hu Barbecue" Across from No. 2 Middle School: Skewer-focused, the cheapest barbecue on the East Campus.
  • Longji Grouper Hot Pot South of No. 2 Middle School: Delicious taste, attentive service, around 100 yuan per person.
  • East Campus Street: Zui'ai, Taipei 1+1 (good atmosphere, suitable for large gatherings), Zhuangyuan Dumplings Mother's Dish, Xian Zonglin, Gaojigu, Potsticker shop.
  • Northwest of Laoshan District Government: Many grilled fish restaurants and food stalls, moderate prices, recommend Yuwei Wuxian (50+ yuan per person).
  • Qinling Road (Hand-eat Restaurant): Specialty hand-grabbed rice.
  • Outside West Campus Small West Gate (UST Back Mountain): Many delicious options, including Korean and Chinese fast food, as well as street snacks. There is a snack shop run by a deaf person at the entrance, recommended. Many fruit stalls there too.
  • Liuqinghe Beach Barbecue: Open-air camping available, run by seniors from the School of Business, negotiable prices, suitable for class or department gatherings.

docs.title: Around Fushan Campus
docs.text:
• East Campus Entrance: Chunxiang Small Noodles, Braised Chicken Rice, McDonald's, Ajisen Ramen.
  • Snack Street Between East and West Campuses: Various snack stalls.
  • Taidong Night Market: Octopus balls, pig trotters, Sister Wang Barbecue, fried yogurt, snack street.

docs.title: Dining Tips
docs.text:
• Payment Methods: Campus card, or Alipay (WeChat Pay not accepted).
  • Takeout: Dining halls provide trays and utensils; no need to bring your own containers. During severe pandemics, the university distributes free disposable bowls.
  • Off-Campus Dining: Outside Jinjialing Campus's Small West Gate, there is a food street with various restaurants, snacks, and barbecue. Outside Fushan Campus's East Campus entrance, there are Chunxiang Small Noodles, Braised Chicken Rice, McDonald's, etc.
  • Campus Card Recharge: Can be done at manual recharge points or via the Youka APP for self-service recharge.
  • Halal Dining: Both Jinjialing Dining Hall 3's third floor and Fushan East Campus Halal Restaurant offer halal meals.
  • Average Monthly Consumption: Generally, 800-1200 yuan/month is sufficient for meals alone, depending on individual circumstances.
  • Business Hours: Basic meal halls usually operate from 6:30-8:30, 10:30-13:00, 16:30-18:30; flavor halls provide all-day non-stop service (6:30-21:30). Hours vary by dining hall.
  • Service Phone: Dining Service Center 85951342; Dietary Department 1 (Fushan West Campus, Songshan Campus) 85951314; Dietary Department 2 (Fushan East Campus) 85953959; Dietary Department 3 (Jinjialing Campus) 85958003

docs.title: Physical Education Classes and Sports Meet
docs.text:
Physical education classes are once a week, with physical fitness tests and final exams each semester. The sports meet is usually held in April with rich events:

  • Men: 100m, 200m, 400m, 800m, 1500m, 5000m, 110m hurdles, relay, high jump, long jump, triple jump, shot put, discus, javelin
  • Women: 100m, 200m, 400m, 800m, 1500m, 3000m, 100m hurdles, relay, high jump, long jump, triple jump, shot put, discus, javelin
  • Group events: Tug-of-war, 1-minute rope skipping, face-to-face relay

docs.title: Bathhouse
docs.text:
Swipe campus card to use. Bathrooms have partitions and shower curtains, can place small baskets, with single and double rooms, large water flow, adjustable temperature. Middle area has lockers for clothes, outside has hair dryers for scan-to-pay use (strong airflow, adjustable temperature and wind speed).

Official Opening Hours (Logistics Management Office)

docs.title: Campus Hospital
docs.text: Qingdao University has a campus hospital on each campus; student enrollment and graduation physical examinations are conducted here. For any major university events, campus doctors are on standby.

docs.title: Treatment Process
docs.text:
Visiting the campus hospital with medical insurance card and medical record allows you to enjoy national discounts, reducing medical expenses.

Standard Treatment Process: 1. Present medical insurance card, medical insurance record, ID card at the registration room (1.5 yuan) 2. Go to the consultation room 3. Network settlement 4. Print invoice, pay 5. Collect medicine from pharmacy

Specific Medicine Purchase Process (no medical insurance coverage): 1. Accurately state the medicine name 2. Present medical insurance card, medical insurance record, ID card at the registration room (0.5 yuan) 3. Get prescription from doctor 4. Return to registration room for payment 5. Collect medicine from pharmacy

Campus Hospital Costs

Campus hospital treatment is not expensive; daily common diseases are very convenient to treat at the campus hospital, with fewer people and lower prices. However, medicine prices may be slightly higher than wholesale prices.

docs.title: Insurance Recommendations
docs.text:
Strongly Recommended

Be sure to join medical insurance after enrollment, pay insurance premiums on time. Once insured, hospital treatment can be reimbursed partially. Additionally, commercial insurance is strongly recommended to avoid heavy financial pressure on families from huge treatment costs in case of accidental injuries.

The university will unify insurance notifications after school starts; participation is voluntary. It is recommended to purchase the university-recommended insurance if financial conditions allow, as it has wide coverage and low premiums.

docs.title: Freshman Physical Examination
docs.text:
• After school starts, unified freshman physical examinations will be arranged; no need to have a physical examination in advance
  • Examination items include: seated forward bend, vital capacity, vision, height, weight, waist circumference, chest circumference, etc.
  • No eating before physical examination (blood draw required)
  • No need to wear underwear for examination

docs.title: Medical Tips
docs.text:
• Recommend bringing common medicines (cold medicine, anti-inflammatory drugs, anti-diarrhea medicine, fever reducers, band-aids, etc.); medicine prices near campus are slightly higher
  • During military training, if feeling unwell, you can take sick leave with a medical record; don't push through
  • Qingdao's climate is humid; lower-floor dormitories may consider preparing dehumidification supplies
  • For mental health needs, contact the university's Psychological Health Education and Research Center

docs.title: Pickup Notice
docs.text:
During the start of school, the university will send special vehicles to welcome freshmen at the following locations (campus buses are marked with "Qingdao University Orientation Pickup", with senior students wearing work badges):

  • Qingdao Railway Station
  • Qingdao Railway Station North ( eight key trains arrive daily, all entering from the northeast direction in the afternoon; the university arranges afternoon pickup)
  • Qingdao Long-Distance Bus Terminal

Beware of Fraud

At bus and railway stations, there may be individuals posing as orientation seniors. Once taken away, you may be forcibly taken to hotels for accommodation. If you encounter especially "enthusiastic" seniors, be sure to request identification and verify with your own seniors.

Train Ticket Discount: For your first train ticket to the university, you can enjoy student ticket discounts (75% off for high-speed rail) at the manual window with your admission notice. This discount is limited to one time and does not support online purchase.

docs.title: Driving Routes from Stations to Campus
1. Qingdao Railway Station
docs.text:
To Fushan Campus: Take Bus 321, 316, or 320 and get off at Qingdao University Station or Qingdao University East Campus Station.

To Jinjialing Campus: - Take Bus 321 directly (most convenient, about 40 minutes) - Bus 307 to Fushan Hou Xiaoqu, transfer to Bus 629 to QDU Higher Vocational College - Bus 312/312 Express to Yinchuan East Road, transfer to Bus 629 - Bus 223 to Guoxin Stadium, transfer to Bus 629

Taxi: Regular taxi starting fare is 9 yuan (about 30 yuan to Fushan Campus, about 50 yuan to Jinjialing Campus).

docs.title: 2. Qingdao Railway Station North
docs.text:
To Jinjialing Campus: - Metro Line 3 to Wannianquan Road (Exit A), walk 150 meters to Nanzhuang Station, take Bus 313 to QDU Higher Vocational College - Or take Bus 606 from Nanzhuang Station to Qingdao No. 2 Middle School, walk to QDU Higher Vocational

To Fushan Campus: - Walk 250 meters to Railway Station North East Square, take Bus 24 or 325 to Inner Mongolia Road Long-Distance Station, transfer to Bus 227 to Qingdao University - Metro Line 3 to Wannianquan Road (Exit A), walk 150 meters to Nanzhuang, take Bus 102 to Qingdao University East Campus

docs.title: 3. Qingdao Long-Distance Bus Terminal
docs.text:
To Fushan Campus: Walk 400 meters to Wenzhou Road Bus Station, take Bus 227 to Qingdao University.

To Jinjialing Campus: Walk to Sifang Long-Distance Station, take Bus 126 to Fuxin Hospital, transfer to Bus 629 to QDU Higher Vocational College.

docs.title: 4. Sifang Long-Distance Station
docs.text:
To Fushan Campus: Take Bus 20, 221, 326, or 366 for one stop to Inner Mongolia Road Long-Distance Station, take Bus 227 Loop Line to Qingdao University.

To Jinjialing Campus: Cross the overpass, take Bus 126 to Liaoning Road East Station, transfer to Bus 313 to the terminal.

Taxi to Fushan Campus is about 20 yuan.

docs.title: 5. Qingdao Jiaodong International Airport
docs.text:
The former Liuting Airport has ceased operations; all flights have been transferred to Qingdao Jiaodong International Airport (farther from the city center).

To Jinjialing Campus: Take airport bus to Convention and Exhibition Center, then taxi to campus.

To Fushan Campus: - Airport bus to Broadcasting and Television Building, take Bus 11, 226, or 301 to Qingdao University - Airport bus to Fushan Suo, take Bus 316, 321, 31, or 125 to Qingdao University

Taxi: From Jiaodong Airport to campus is expensive (about 100-150 yuan); airport bus is recommended.

docs.title: 6. Parent Drop-off
docs.text:
Parents driving students please note that Qingdao has many one-way street settings, which can easily cause confusion or penalty points.

  • After exiting the Qingyin Expressway, to go to Jinjialing Campus, directly turn left at Liaoyang East Road, go east to Songling Road and turn right, then go straight south.
  • To go to Fushan Campus, exit the expressway and go west to Shenzhen Road, turn south, go straight to Hong Kong East Road, then turn right and go straight (west).

Parent Parking: On registration day, parents are not allowed to drive into the university (high traffic, no parking spaces, easy congestion); park in nearby off-campus parking lots.

Parent Accommodation: Use Alipay, Meituan, or similar apps to search for nearby hotels.

docs.title: Transportation Between Two Campuses
docs.text: Bus 321 provides direct service, taking about 40 minutes, and is the main bus line connecting Jinjialing and Fushan Campuses.

docs.title: On-Campus Shuttle Bus
docs.text:
The university provides shuttle buses between the two campuses (inter-campus buses) for cross-campus classes and errands. Below is the bus information published by the Logistics Management Office (summer/winter departure times differ):

Route Departure Time Route Fushan → Jinjialing Summer 13:20 / Winter 12:50 Fushan Campus Administration Building → Jinjialing Campus Shouzheng Building Jinjialing → Fushan 7:20, 12:15, Summer 17:30 / Winter 17:00 Jinjialing Campus Shouzheng Building → Fushan Campus Administration Building Elective Course (Jinjialing → Fushan) Summer 21:00 / Winter 20:30 Jinjialing Campus Shouzheng Building → Fushan Campus Administration Building

Inter-campus Bus Tips

The inter-campus bus mainly serves cross-campus classes and commuting. Schedule changes are subject to university logistics notices. Additionally, the university has shuttle buses from various city directions to both campuses (Guangrao Road, No. 17 Middle School, Yichun Road, Lijin Road, Beiling, Zhongshan Road, Hushan, etc.), mostly used by faculty and staff; students can also pay attention if in a hurry.
