docs.title: Beach Barbecue
docs.text: Take a bus to Liuqinghe for beach barbecue and open-air camping. There is a beach barbecue run by seniors from QDU's School of Business; negotiable prices, many game options, suitable for class or department gatherings.

docs.title: Travel Tips
docs.text:
• Bus Payment: Search "Qindaotong" electronic card in Alipay, or use phone NFC bus card.
  • Metro: Qingdao Metro has opened multiple lines; download the "Qingdao Metro" APP on your phone to ride.
  • Shared Transportation: No shared bikes on campus; Jinjialing Campus has many steps and slopes; bicycles/electric vehicles are not recommended.
  • Weekend Travel: You can leave campus freely when there are no classes, but pay attention to dormitory curfew (generally must return before 11:30 PM).
  • Taxis: Regular taxi starting fare 9 yuan, black premium taxi starting fare 12 yuan.

docs.title: Pickup Safety Tips
docs.text:
1. QDU shuttle buses will have "QDU Welcome Pickup" signs. Staff will wear work badges, student IDs, and academic affairs pickup IDs
  2. At bus and train stations, criminals may pretend to be welcome staff. If taken away, you may be forced into hotel stays or pushed to buy overpriced items
  3. If you encounter overly "enthusiastic" seniors, ask for their credentials and contact your own seniors to verify
  4. School pickup locations: Qingdao Railway Station, Qingdao Railway Station North, Qingdao Long-distance Bus Terminal

docs.title: Travel Safety
docs.text:
1. Buy tickets in advance (1-2 weeks) to match your university registration schedule
  2. On the train, don't discuss your family situation with strangers, especially home address and phone number
  3. If you receive news about a family member "in trouble," verify thoroughly. This is a common scam
  4. Keep your luggage close and carry valuables with you

docs.title: Property Safety
docs.text:
1. In an unfamiliar environment, bring fewer valuables. With modern logistics, laptops, cameras etc. can be sent later or mailed
  2. Be wary of overly "helpful" seniors. Carry your own bags with valuables to prevent theft
  3. Don't buy school supplies from unofficial sources (door-to-door sales of pens, notebooks are often overpriced, poor quality)
  4. Campus management is chaotic at the start with many outsiders; watch your belongings

docs.title: Dormitory Safety
docs.text:
1. Dorms have 24/7 power, 220V. High-power appliances are strictly prohibited (hair dryers, curling irons, electric cookers, etc.)
  2. Using high-power appliances will trigger automatic power cut. Power can only be restored after reporting to college and dorm management
  3. Since 2025, dorms have full AC coverage with heating in all rooms
  4. Dorm outlets only work for charging; other appliances won't work due to power limits
  5. Lock doors and windows when leaving, keep personal items safe
  6. Bring your own small lock for dorm lockers

docs.title: Online Fraud Prevention
docs.text:
1. Campus loans: Never trust campus loan advertisements. Interest rates are extremely high with severe consequences. Contact your counselor for financial aid or student loans
  2. Click-farming jobs: All "click-farm rebates" are scams, don't believe them
  3. Fake customer service: If called by someone claiming to be Taobao/JD customer service about product issues and refunds, verify through official channels
  4. Impersonating teachers/classmates: If someone on QQ/WeChat claims to be a teacher or classmate borrowing money, verify by phone
  5. Link scams: Don't click links in unknown texts or messages, especially those requesting bank card information

docs.title: Sales Traps
docs.text:
1. Reject all door-to-door sales (English newspapers, cosmetics, cleaners, etc.) and don't let strangers into your dorm
  2. Training agencies may promote computer certificate courses on campus. The school doesn't organize unified training, and teachers say it's useless
  3. There may be campus SIM card promotions by carriers and student collaborators. Choose based on needs; these are not official
  4. Don't buy school supplies from unofficial sources

docs.title: Personal Information Protection
docs.text:
1. Don't lend ID cards, bank cards, student IDs or other important documents
  2. Don't fill in personal information on unknown websites or apps
  3. Mark photocopies with "for XXX use only"
  4. Smart League Building, military recruitment info etc. follow school announcements. Online rumors about "must register or can't sign up" are false

docs.title: Campus Card Security
docs.text:
1. Campus card is essential for dining, showering, and dorm access. Don't lend it to others
  2. If your card is lost, immediately use the "Youka" APP to report it, or go to manual top-up points or self-service machines
  3. After replacement, re-register access by bringing your student ID to Duxing Building Room 403

docs.title: Other Common Scams
docs.text:
1. Shilaoren scenic area etc.: People in cartoon costumes will try to drag you for photos — it's a scam. Never take photos with them
  2. "Helpful" people at stations: They'll carry your luggage and guide you to transport, then demand high fees
  3. "Cheap branded goods" in dorms: People selling "cheap" branded products (shampoo, cosmetics) are almost always selling fakes
  4. "Seniors" selling things: After school starts, self-proclaimed seniors sell overpriced items with no quality guarantee

docs.title: Emergency Response
docs.text:
• If scammed or in danger, contact your counselor immediately or call campus security
  • Security office: Fushan Campus 85951110, Jinjialing Campus 85959110
  • Preserve evidence of scams (chat records, transfer records, etc.)
  • Call 110 if necessary

docs.title: Anti-Fraud Summary
docs.text:
One rule: Don't trust, don't reveal, don't transfer, don't be greedy.

For anything involving money, ask your counselor or seniors first; reject all door-to-door sales; verify all online transfer requests.

docs.title: New Student Communication Channels
docs.text:
Welcome to follow the Qingdao University Tieba for more new student information!

Official new student group information for each college and major will be included with the admission notice. Please check the booklet inside the notice. You can also follow your college’s official website or WeChat official account for the latest new student group information.

docs.title: Basic Military Training Arrangements
docs.text:
• Starts the day after registration – uniform distribution and training begin
  • Duration is about two weeks (around ten days), relatively short
  • Training includes: standing at attention, marching in step, stepping in place, at ease, and other basic drills
  • The College of Computer Science and Technology may have a special demonstration platoon (selected male students will be chosen later for training)
  • Morning and afternoon sessions are each about four hours, with dismissal times varying depending on the situation
  • No night training, no 800-meter run
  • No forced marches, focused on basic drills
  • At the end there is a military parade, with all colleges participating; each college selects one formation for the training performance
  • No classes during the training period; there may be activities on the last day
  • After military training comes the opening ceremony, where you will march in formation

docs.title: Daily Schedule Reference
docs.text:
Period Approximate Time Morning wake-up After 7:00 AM Morning training About four hours Lunch break ends Around 1:00 PM afternoon training About four hours Evening Free rest, no night training

The specific schedule will be issued during training; just wake up twenty minutes ahead of the schedule.

docs.title: Temporary Person-in-Charge During Training
docs.text: During the training period there is a temporary person-in-charge (similar to a class assistant role). You can sign up individually; the class monitor will notify you.

docs.title: Uniform Contents
docs.text: Uniforms are ordered collectively by the school. The set includes: hat, short-sleeve T-shirt, long-sleeve jacket, belt (worn outside), pants, socks, shoes, shoulder boards, and badges.

docs.title: Size Selection
docs.text:
• A booklet with ordering instructions is included with the admission notice; choose your size in advance as directed
  • You can also pick up the appropriate size after the semester starts based on your height and weight
  • If it doesn’t fit, you can exchange it after the semester starts
  • After receiving the uniform, be sure to try it on; if an exchange is needed, return to the distribution point immediately

docs.title: Shoes and Insoles
docs.text:
• Shoes are provided uniformly; recommend going half a size up, and use insoles or extra-large cotton sanitary pads inside
  • The provided insoles are not very comfortable; it is strongly recommended to bring your own thick insoles or sanitary pads
  • Take care of your feet – use insoles

docs.title: Sanitary Pad Size Reference (as Training Insoles)
docs.text:
Shoe Size Recommended Specification 35–39 Limited information; buy according to your own feet 39–41 Whispers Cotton Soft Night 275mm / Seven Space Pure Cotton Night 275mm / ABC Cotton Soft Night 280mm 42–42.5 Freedom Point Pure Cotton Night 280mm / Whispers Cotton Soft Night 284mm 43–43.5 Sophie Cotton Soft Night 290mm / Anlene Soft Cotton Extra-Long Night 290mm 44–45 Get a larger shoe size; look for any 317/323/338mm

Recommended brands: Sophie, ABC (ABC may be cooler). Avoid no-name brands.

docs.title: Hairstyle and Accessories
docs.text:
• During training, all hair must be tied up
  • No special requirements; try to not cover your ears and eyes
  • No hair color restrictions
  • You cannot wear necklaces, earrings, or other accessories
  • Long hair must be coiled and tucked into the hat
  • Ice sleeves are not allowed during training

docs.title: Recommended to Bring
docs.text: Small hair clips and hair ties (to secure loose hair and keep hair in place).

docs.title: Sun Protection and Heatstroke Prevention
docs.text:
Sun protection is of utmost importance

Qingdao is located by the sea, and UV radiation is strong in August and September. Without sun protection, sunburn is very likely. Don’t think being a little tanner is fine; Qingdao’s tanning efficiency is extremely high, and sunburn is very painful.

docs.title: Sun Protection Tips
docs.text:
• Apply sunscreen half an hour before going out to allow time for absorption
  • Carry sunscreen with you; generally reapply every two hours
  • Correct steps: First use oil-absorbing paper to clean your face, then apply sunscreen
  • You sweat a lot during training; whenever the instructor lets you rest, apply more
  • Recommended: sunscreen with UVA protection (those with PA rating)
  • During rest periods, you are allowed to apply sunscreen and drink water

docs.title: Heatstroke Prevention
docs.text:
• Prepare Huoxiang Zhengqi Water (for preventing heatstroke)
  • If sunburn causes serious skin problems, you may be exempt from training; get your medical records and diagnosis ready in advance
  • If you are sick, absolutely do not push through

docs.title: Recommended Items Checklist
docs.text: Category Item Notes Sun protection Sunscreen, sunscreen spray Strongly recommended; Qingdao has high UV Hydration Large-capacity water bottle Very important; stay hydrated Cleaning Wet wipes, tissues For wiping sweat and cleaning Insoles Thick insoles, sanitary pads Provided insoles are uncomfortable; essential Hair Small hair clips, hair ties Keep hair tied up Supply Appropriate amount of sugar Prevent low blood sugar Medical Band-aids For treating minor wounds Backpack School bag / shoulder bag For personal items; place in designated area

docs.title: Dietary Advice
docs.text:
1. Eat on time; never train on an empty stomach
  2. Physical exertion is extremely high after training; eat more meat and eggs, and drink more soup and vegetable broth
  3. Pay attention to supplementing various vitamins
  4. If you have low blood sugar, it’s best to carry sugar with you
  5. Sports drinks, tea, and salt water are best; don’t drink excessive amounts of plain water or mineral water (which can cause water intoxication; you need to supplement salt appropriately)

docs.title: Health Precautions
docs.text:
1. After heavy rain or profuse sweating, don’t rush to drink water; rest a little first before drinking to avoid harm to your gastrointestinal system
  2. During training you should persevere, but if you really can’t hold on, you must rest and not push through, especially for students with weaker constitutions
  3. If you feel unwell, you can take a day or half-day leave
  4. During training, maintain a regular schedule to conserve energy

docs.title: Other Notes
docs.text:
• You can bring a school bag; it will be placed in a designated area
  • It is still recommended to bring a computer during training; the campus will be crowded with various people during this time, and although valuables are easily lost, you may need to select courses, so it’s best to properly secure your valuables and lock your dorm room
  • Before going out, carefully check your training uniform: military cap, cap badge, arm insignia, belt, etc., or you will be criticized or punished by the instructor
  • During training, you don’t have to use the school-provided bed sheets and duvet covers; you can use your own
  • Bedding from the school is not mandatory; using the school’s standard sizes makes tidying the dorm easier
  • Make sure your outfit is appropriate; check before going out
  • Learn about something called the “retirement squad” or “leave of absence”
  • Communicate: During military training, learn to communicate with classmates; if you have difficulties, humbly seek help from classmates and teachers (wearing uniforms, marching, standing at attention, folding military quilts, etc.)

docs.title: What to Do on Registration Day
docs.text: Registration day mainly involves: new student check-in, collecting campus card, getting dormitory keys, moving into dorms, familiarizing with campus, attending orientation meeting, etc. The specific registration time will be announced by the school. As for when to arrive — it's crowded no matter when you go, so don't overthink it.

docs.title: Registration Location
docs.text:
• CS College and other science/engineering departments: Freshmen at Jinjialing Campus (East Campus), moving to Fushan Campus from sophomore year
  • Other colleges: Based on the campus information on your admission letter

Not sure which campus to go to?

Click to view Campus & Department Contacts to find your registration campus and department office phone number based on your college on the admission letter.

docs.title: Detailed Registration Process
docs.text:
1. After arriving at school, find your college's welcome staff (they'll be holding college flags), who will guide you to the new student reception
  2. At the reception, complete new student verification by presenting your ID card, admission letter, and exam ticket. Students bringing their own files need to submit them
  3. Collect your registration certificate, which shows your college and student number
  4. With the registration certificate, complete accommodation procedures at the dormitory management center or apartment office to get your dormitory key
  5. Put your luggage in the dormitory
  6. Go to the centralized office to complete enrollment procedures:
  7. Pay tuition and fees (students who had automatic bank deduction can collect receipts with admission letter)
  8. Household registration transfer (Security Office, submit transfer certificate)
  9. Insurance (Student Affairs Office, voluntary)
  10. Campus card (Logistics Group)
  11. Party/League membership transfer (Youth League Committee, submit introduction letter)
  12. Green Channel (Student Affairs Office, students from financially disadvantaged families can enroll first and receive aid later)

docs.title: Can Parents Enter Campus?
docs.text: During orientation, parents can enter the campus and help move into dorms. Driving into campus may require a pass.

docs.title: Can I Register Early?
docs.text: You cannot arrive 1-2 days early. You must register according to the school's orientation schedule. However, you can arrive in Qingdao early to settle in.

docs.title: Required Documents
docs.text:
1. ID card (original)
  2. College entrance exam ticket
  3. Admission letter
  4. League/Party membership certificate
  5. File folder: containing student status materials, League organization relationship certificate (envelope) or Party organization relationship certificate (envelope)
  6. 1-inch photos: about 10 copies (for registration, student ID card, student organizations, clubs, Party membership, resume, work-study applications, student ID replacement, etc.), keep digital copies for printing as needed
  7. 2-inch photos: 4-8 copies (used less frequently)
  8. ID card photocopies (front and back) and household registration photocopies (first page and personal page), 2 copies each
  9. Bank deposit receipt (if lost, can get a new certificate from the bank)
  10. Portrait photo: Go to a photo studio for a student ID photo, prepare red, blue, and white background versions

Photo Tips

No specific background color requirement for ID photos. Prepare both 1-inch and 2-inch sizes.​最好​不要​戴眼镜​ for ID photos. Keep digital copies safe.

docs.title: Loan Application
docs.text:
After loans begin, local loan departments will issue relevant regulations. Prepare materials (requirements vary by location). Generally needed: - Original and photocopies of borrower and co-borrower ID cards - Original household registration book - Original and photocopy of admission letter - Certificate from village/township/street office

Log in to the National Development Bank Student Online Service System (http://www.csls.cdb.com.cn) to register, fill out and print the application form with official stamp.

docs.title: After the Loan
docs.text:
• Bring the loan contract and receipt when school starts; the school will record loan students
  • Money arrives in about 2-3 months
  • No need to deposit tuition in school bank account if you have a loan — only deposit living expenses
  • Excess loan funds can be used for living expenses

Alipay Real-name Registration

The Alipay account used for student loans must be real-name registered, otherwise funds will be frozen. Frozen funds can only be viewed on computer, not on mobile.

docs.title: Financial Aid Application
docs.text: The application form in the admission letter can be used for financial aid applications after school starts (unrelated to loans). It needs official stamps. Bringing additional certificates is optional.

docs.title: Household Registration Transfer
docs.text: New students can apply for household registration transfer. Voluntary, not mandatory. If you don't plan to develop your career in Qingdao, there's no need to transfer. Transferring household registration has limited benefits — discuss with your parents.

docs.title: Tuition System
docs.text:
Qingdao University charges tuition on a credit system. Except for some Sino-foreign cooperative programs that charge annually at a fixed price, other programs charge per semester based on credits taken.

  • Since course numbers vary each semester, tuition amounts also differ
  • Over four years, total tuition paid is fixed
  • Most programs cost about 25,000 yuan over four years; medical programs slightly more
  • "Average 6,000 yuan per year" in admissions brochure is for easy understanding
  • School automatically deducts from CCB card; online payment also available

docs.title: Train Ticket Discount
docs.text:
The first train trip to school qualifies for student ticket discount at the ticket window with your admission letter (hard seat half price, high-speed rail 25% off). You can also buy student tickets online and apply for the discount at any time before departure at the ticket window.

Money-saving Tip

Students from far away can save a lot. Make sure to use this discount.

docs.text: You can mail luggage and supplies to school before the semester starts:

docs.title: Summer Clothes
docs.text: Hot during and after military training, but weather turns cool after training ends. Don't bring too many summer clothes (summer lasts about one month).

docs.title: Autumn Clothes
docs.text: Autumn brings strong winds due to Qingdao's geographical location. Wind-resistant clothing recommended. Don't dress too warmly as indoor-outdoor temperature difference is large (autumn lasts about two months).

docs.title: Winter Clothes
docs.text: Windy, humid, and sometimes extremely cold. Down jacket + light layers can handle most winter days. Add a sweater for severe cold (winter lasts about two months).

docs.title: Shoes
docs.text: Sneakers, canvas shoes, basketball shoes, warm shoes (bring warm shoes if from far away). Slippers can be purchased at school.

docs.title: Toiletries
docs.text:
Towel, soap, shampoo, toothbrush, toothpaste, cup, body wash, soap dish, comb, shoe brush, laundry detergent (can buy large pack with dormmates), laundry liquid, basin, bath towel, shower bag, shower ball, shower cap, hand cream, hand soap, facial cleanser, conditioner, sunscreen/spray (strongly recommended, strong UV at seaside), face mask.

Packing Tip

Bring small bottles for laundry detergent/powder for convenience.

docs.title: Dining Supplies
docs.text: Lunch box (for instant noodles or fruit, not essential), utensils, water cup, water bottle, dish soap.

docs.title: Essential Items
docs.text:
• Some cash: 100 yuan is enough (for Fushan Campus water card purchase), don't bring large amounts
  • Phone, earphones, charging cable, power bank
  • Bank card: School-issued CCB card (for tuition deduction) + your own bank card. Transfer from your own card to avoid handling fees
  • Radio: Required for English exams, can be purchased through school or bought separately
  • Mosquito repellent (really needed next semester)

docs.title: Optional Items
docs.text: USB drive, low-power desk lamp, power strip (one per person), nail clipper, ear pick, scissors, fruit knife, sewing kit, clothes hangers, small flashlight, toilet paper, tissues, sanitary pads, glue stick, double-sided tape, mirror, hot water bottle, hand warmers, food storage bags, garbage bags, wallet, small hooks, small lock (for locker), 4m thick rope (in case no drying line), large clips (for quilts), circular hanger (for socks), mothballs.

docs.title: Laptop
docs.text:
You can bring your laptop after the National Day holiday. During military training, the campus is crowded and students are often away from dorms, so there's a small risk of valuables being lost. Laptops won't be used much before October, but they're convenient for course selection (rushing for PE and elective courses is easier than on phone).

Laptop Purchase

Not recommended to use Apple MacBook as all learning software is Windows-based. For non-gamers, an integrated graphics thin-and-light laptop with good CPU is fine. CS students recommended 32GB RAM or expandable memory.

docs.title: Online Shopping
docs.text: Bed desk, low-power fan (recommended to buy next semester), curtains (some dorms need them), ladder pad (for bunk beds).

docs.title: Medicine
docs.text:
Most students may experience altitude sickness at first. Campus-area pharmacies are slightly expensive. Recommended to bring:

  • Wind oil essence, floral water (commonly used next semester, also refreshing)
  • Vitamin C, Vitamin B
  • Watermelon frost spray, ice boron powder (for mouth ulcers)
  • Stomach medicine (essential for those with stomach issues)
  • Anti-inflammatory medicine (roxithromycin, amoxicillin)
  • Cold medicine
  • Fever reducer (aspirin)
  • Bandages, gauze, medical cotton, cotton swabs
  • Band-aids
  • Anti-diarrhea medicine
  • Huoxiang Zhengqi water (prevents heatstroke during military training)

docs.title: School Supplies
docs.text: Only need pens and notebooks — buy at school after arrival. Don't buy school supplies from unofficial sources.

docs.title: Bedding
docs.text:
Provided by school (instructions in admission letter):

Quilt, mattress, wool pad, quilt cover ×2, bed sheet ×2, mosquito net, pillow core, pillow towel ×2, pillowcase ×2, summer quilt, bedding bag.

School bedding can only be ordered as a complete set, quality is decent. You can also bring everything yourself.

docs.title: Freshman Course Selection
docs.text: First semester freshmen only need to select PE class. Course selection is announced during later military training. Other courses arranged by academic affairs.

docs.title: General Electives
docs.text: Courses divided into core and non-core. Non-core courses are generally easier, like "Qingdao Tourism Geography". Need 6 credits for core, 4 for non-core, 2 for aesthetics. Freshman priority is low — popular courses recommended for sophomore/junior year.

docs.title: Schedule Lookup
docs.text: After schedule is set, search "QDU Academic Affairs" on Baidu to log in, or use WeChat account "Qingxiaozhu".

docs.title: Common Expenses Reference
docs.text:
• Living expenses: 800-1200 yuan/month for food alone, varies by person
  • Tuition: Determined by credits, most programs about 25,000 yuan over four years
  • Textbooks: Distributed at start of semester
  • Physical exam: Arranged by school, no need for pre-exam

docs.title: High School Files
docs.text: Bring high school files and League files to school during registration. File folder contains student status materials and League/Party relationship certificates.

docs.title: League Membership Transfer
docs.text: League membership transferred by class League secretary through the "Smart League Building" system. Processed after school starts. Don't rush if high school pushes you. Introduction letter and transfer documents should be in one envelope — bring it to school.

docs.title: Party Membership Application
docs.text: First submit application, then become an activist through organizational observation, then probationary member, then full member. Quarterly thought reports required. Applications typically submitted during or after military training.

docs.title: Other Notes
docs.text:
• Class assignment: Randomized based on student origin and gender ratio, not by grades
  • Bank card activation: CCB card from admission letter can be activated in Qingdao at any CCB branch. Possible small perks for activating in Qingdao
  • Campus SIM card: Don't have to use the one from admission letter. Choose freely. Can also register at college on registration day
  • Daily supplies purchase: Most dorm supplies available at school stores. You can even just bring change of clothes

docs.title: Undergraduate Handbook
docs.text:
Content based on the 2022 Student Handbook

This article is compiled from the 2022 "Qingdao University Student Handbook" (containing various regulatory documents, mostly from 2017–2022). Policies on enrollment status, degrees, financial aid, etc. may be adjusted yearly. This article is for understanding the general framework; please refer to the university's currently valid documents for specifics. 📥 Click to download: Qingdao University Student Handbook PDF

Everyone gets one at enrollment; you flip through it for a couple of days at the start of the semester, then it gathers dust. You only realize its usefulness when something happens This little booklet actually contains the most important rules you should know during your four years at Qingdao University. Here we highlight the key points.

docs.title: In a Nutshell
docs.text: The Student Handbook = Qingdao University's "General Regulations," covering enrollment management, student ID and leave, degree conferral, scholarships and financial aid, disciplinary actions, exam violations, etc. It is both your list of rights (how to get scholarships, how to secure postgraduate recommendation) and your behavioral red lines (what happens if you fail exams, cheat, or skip classes).

docs.title: Enrollment Management
docs.text:
Related sections

For credit system, graduation credit requirements, tuition and course selection, see Academic System.

docs.title: Flexible Study Period (QDU-Jiao-〔2017〕No. 12)
docs.text:
The university implements a flexible study period. The basic program length is only the minimum; you can delay graduation (as long as you don’t exceed the upper limit):

Program Type Study Period Range Four-year non-medical programs 3–8 years Four-year medical programs 4–8 years Five-year medical programs 5–10 years Two-year equivalent connection segmented training 2–4 years

docs.title: Enrollment and Registration
docs.text:
• New students must report to the university within the specified period; if you cannot enroll on time due to special circumstances, you must apply for leave in advance. Failure to do so or arriving after the deadline will be considered as giving up enrollment eligibility.
  • Within 3 months after enrollment, the university will conduct an enrollment eligibility review (identity, physical examination, professional level for arts/sports, etc.)
  • Every semester you must complete registration procedures; if you cannot register on time, you must apply for delayed registration; those who haven’t paid fees or don’t meet requirements will not be registered.
  • An unregistered student ID is invalid.

docs.title: Leave of Absence and Re-enrollment
docs.text:
• You may apply for leave of absence due to illness or other reasons; the university also retains the right to handle cases where leave should be taken.
  • During leave, your enrollment status is retained but you do not enjoy the benefits of an active student; medical expenses are handled according to national regulations.
  • For students who join the military, the university retains their enrollment eligibility or enrollment status for up to 2 years after discharge.
  • Before the end of the leave period, you must apply for re-enrollment within the specified period; re-enrollment is only allowed after passing the review.

docs.title: Red Lines for Withdrawal
docs.text:
The university may process withdrawal in any of the following situations:

  • Academic performance does not meet requirements, or the student has not completed their studies within the prescribed study period
  • Leave of absence or retained enrollment status has expired, and the student has not applied for re-enrollment on time or has failed the review
  • Diagnosed by a designated hospital as unable to continue studying due to illness or disability
  • Without approval, failing to participate in school-required teaching activities for two consecutive weeks
  • Failing to register beyond the prescribed period without completing delayed registration procedures

Related sections

If you fail too many courses or don’t earn enough credits, you will first receive an Academic Warning. Don’t wait until withdrawal to panic.

docs.title: Transfer (Very Difficult – Don’t Count on It)
docs.text:
If you are unable to study at this university due to illness or special difficulties, you may apply for transfer, but transfer is not allowed in the following situations:

  • Less than one semester after enrollment or in the final year before graduation
  • Your college entrance examination score is lower than the admission score of the relevant major at the intended receiving university for the same source region and corresponding year
  • Transferring from a lower educational level to a higher one
  • Enrolled through targeted employment admission
  • No valid reason for transfer

Related sections

Want to change your major? Transfer of major and transfer of university are not the same thing. For rules and procedures on changing majors, see Change of Major.

docs.title: Student ID
docs.text:
Based on the "Qingdao University Student ID and School Badge Management Measures" (QDU-Jiao-〔2014〕No. 17):

  • After new student enrollment and registration, the Academic Affairs Office will issue student IDs and school badges and register them.
  • Every semester, present your student ID to your college to complete registration; an unregistered student ID is invalid.
  • Student IDs and school badges are for personal use only; they must not be altered, lent, gifted to others, or used as collateral.
  • If your home address changes and the travel zone on your student ID needs to be updated, you must provide household registration proof or a certificate from your parents’ employer; changes will be made after review and approval.
  • Week 5 and Week 15 of each semester are for handling replacements; you need to fill out an application form, provide a one-inch bareheaded photo, and the college will process it collectively.
  • Upon graduation, the college will stamp "Graduation Souvenir" on the student ID and cancel it.
  • Lost school badges are generally not replaced.

Uses of the Student ID

To buy discounted student train tickets, you need to attach a magnetic strip; the travel zone should be set to the station closest to your home. Magnetic reloading is done at designated times each year; see Campus Card and Certificates for details. The complete process for replacing a lost student ID and for reporting and replacing a lost campus card is also on that page.

docs.title: Leave of Absence
docs.text:
Based on the "Qingdao University Student Leave Management Measures" (QDU-Ban-〔2017〕No. 12):

  • Leave must be applied for in advance through written procedures to your counselor (class advisor); if an online leave system is available, you may apply online. In special cases, you may apply verbally/communicatively and complete the procedures afterward.
  • For sick leave, you must provide medical records, diagnosis certificate, and sick leave proof; leave exceeding 5 days requires proof from a Grade II-A or higher hospital.

docs.title: Approval Authority
docs.text:
Leave Duration Approved By Up to 2 days (including 2 days) Counselor (class advisor) More than 2 days, up to 7 days (including 7 days) College administrator More than 7 days College principal Leave during exam period Must be approved by the college principal and reported to the academic affairs department

Pay attention to the limit

A single leave request cannot exceed 4 weeks; for serious illness or other special reasons, it cannot exceed 6 weeks; if cumulative leave in a semester exceeds 6 weeks, you must complete leave of absence procedures. Failure to return from leave on time is counted as truancy; falsifying information or forging documentation is treated as unauthorized leave and will result in disciplinary action.

docs.title: Exams and Grades
docs.text:
• Exam courses typically have 90-minute midterms and 120-minute finals; assessment courses are generally 90 minutes.
  • Assessment grades are recorded in the grade book and filed in the enrollment record; grades obtained through make-up exams or course retakes are marked accordingly.
  • For serious violations of exam discipline or cheating, the course grade is recorded as invalid, and disciplinary action will be taken based on severity; for warnings, serious warnings, demerits, or probation, good behavior may allow a make-up exam or retake opportunity.

Related sections

For specific operations on CET-4/6, make-up exams and retakes, physical fitness tests, and grade inquiries, see Exams and Grades; for exam room rules and violation handling, see Exam Management Regulations.

docs.title: Postgraduate Recommendation (Exemption from Entrance Exam)
docs.text: Based on the "Qingdao University Implementation Measures for Recommending Outstanding Graduating Undergraduate Students for Postgraduate Exemption" (QDU-Jiao-〔2021〕No. 21):

docs.title: Basic Conditions
docs.text:
• Current graduating undergraduate students (excluding college-to-university transfers and second bachelor’s degree students)
  • Moral quality evaluation of good or above, with no record of any violation of laws or regulations
  • No failing grades in required courses
  • For the first three years (four-year programs) / first four years (five-year programs), exam course average grade ranking within the top 30% of the major (innovation experimental classes and excellence talent plans may relax to 40%; those with truly special academic expertise may relax to 50%)
  • Foreign language requirement: Non-foreign-language major English students must have CET-6 score of 426 or above (or IELTS 6, TOEFL 80); arts and sports majors require CET-4 score of 426 or above.

docs.title: How Rankings Are Calculated
docs.text:
Comprehensive Score = Academic Score × 90% + Comprehensive Development Quality Evaluation Score × 10%

  • Academic score is calculated from exam course grades, with a maximum of 100 points.
  • Comprehensive development quality includes social practice (military service, volunteer service, international organization internships) and special academic expertise (competition awards, research achievements).
  • The same research outcome or competition project is counted at the highest level only; no duplicate scoring.

docs.title: Other Key Points
docs.text:
• You may not apply for different categories of postgraduate recommendation simultaneously (regular recommendation, counselor recommendation, etc.)
  • After obtaining recommendation eligibility, you must contact the receiving institution yourself and obtain admission qualification before the date specified by the Ministry of Education; otherwise it is considered automatic forfeiture.
  • Those who have been confirmed as recommended students will have their recommendation eligibility revoked if they receive disciplinary action or cannot graduate normally before graduation; any falsification discovered during the application will result in disqualification and strict handling.

Related sections

For the complete strategy for postgraduate recommendation (quota allocation, comprehensive development quality bonus details, special expertise defense, process timeline), see Exams and Grades – Postgraduate Recommendation.

docs.title: Degree Conferral
docs.text:
Based on the "Qingdao University Provisional Regulations on Bachelor's Degree Conferral" (QDU-Xuewei-〔2016〕No. 4):

  • If you complete all content of the training plan within the prescribed study period, earn the required credits, and meet the graduation requirements in moral, intellectual, and physical aspects, you may apply for a bachelor's degree.
  • If your minor major and primary major belong to different discipline categories and both meet the standards, two degrees may be conferred simultaneously; if you do not obtain the primary major degree, you cannot apply for a second degree.

Cheating destroys degree eligibility

  • Those who receive disciplinary action for exam cheating will not have their degree application accepted in the graduation season (with good performance, it may be conferred at the next review upon special recommendation by the college degree evaluation subcommittee and approval by the university degree evaluation committee).
  • For other violations resulting in "demerit or above" (including demerit) disciplinary action where less than one year has passed since the sanction, bachelor's degree applications will not be accepted.
  • Thesis fraud is handled according to the "Provisional Measures for Handling Thesis Fraud."

docs.title: Scholarships and Financial Aid (Directly Related to Money)
docs.text:
Based on the "Qingdao University Student Financial Aid Management Measures" (QDU-Xue-〔2022〕No. 17) and various evaluation methods:

Related sections

Scholarship evaluation is based on comprehensive assessment scores. For how comprehensive assessment is calculated and how to earn bonus points, see Comprehensive Assessment.

docs.title: Government Financial Aid Programs
docs.text: Program Amount Key Requirements National Scholarship 8,000 yuan/year Exceptionally outstanding, second year or above, grades and comprehensive assessment both in top 10%, no failing grades Provincial Government Scholarship 6,000 yuan/year Exceptionally outstanding, second year or above, grades and comprehensive assessment both in top 15% National Encouragement Scholarship 5,000 yuan/year Excellent character and academic performance + family financial difficulty, second year or above, one in top 30%, the other in top 50% Provincial Government Encouragement Scholarship 5,000 yuan/year Same as above Xinjiang/Tibet/Qinghai Haibei Ethnic Minority Encouragement Scholarship 5,000 yuan/year Household registration in Xinjiang/Tibet/Qinghai Haibei, ethnic minority National Financial Aid Tier 1: 2,300 / Tier 2: 3,300 / Tier 3: 4,300 yuan/year Family financial difficulty (average about 3,300) Origin-Place Credit Student Loan Undergraduate: up to 12,000 yuan/year Government-led, government-subsidized interest Military Service Education Financial Aid Tuition compensation/loan repayment/exemption, undergraduate: up to 12,000 yuan/year Enlisted or returning from military service

docs.title: University Financial Aid Programs
docs.text: Program Amount Notes President's Scholarship 5,000 yuan/academic year 100 recipients university-wide annually Undergraduate Excellence Scholarship 1,000 / 600 / 400 yuan/semester By tier Undergraduate Progress Scholarship 200 yuan/semester Progress award Competition Scholarship Depends on competition level Representing the university and winning awards Sports Scholarship Depends on competition level Athletes winning awards at city level or above Work-Study Program Paid by position Priority for students with family financial difficulty Emergency Financial Aid Tier 1: 2,000 / Tier 2: 1,500 / Tier 3: 1,000 In case of special circumstances Visiting Comfort Fund Tier 1: 2,000 / Tier 2: 1,000 / Tier 3: 500 Students with special difficulties

docs.title: Evaluation Process and Notes
docs.text:
• Process: Individual application → Class evaluation → College preliminary evaluation and public announcement → University evaluation and public announcement (winning lists are publicly announced university-wide for no less than 5 working days)
  • National/provincial government scholarships are evaluated once per academic year, generally from September to November.
  • In the same academic year, National Scholarship and Provincial Government Scholarship cannot be held simultaneously; students with family financial difficulty who receive national/provincial government scholarships may also apply for National Financial Aid, but cannot simultaneously receive the Encouragement Scholarship.
  • Family financial difficulty identification is divided into three tiers: general difficulty, difficulty, special difficulty, conducted through a "three-level identification, two-level public announcement" procedure.
  • Those who conceal family circumstances or provide false information will have their eligibility revoked; those who receive aid and then engage in extravagance will have funds reclaimed.

Green Channel

New students with family financial difficulty may use the "Green Channel" to complete enrollment procedures first, then apply for financial aid, tuition exemption, or student loans as required. If you have difficulties, don’t struggle alone; contact your counselor or the Student Financial Aid Management Center.

docs.title: Disciplinary Actions (Behavioral Red Lines)
docs.text: Based on the "Qingdao University Student Disciplinary Action Management Regulations" (QDU-Ban-〔2017〕No. 13):

docs.title: Types and Durations of Disciplinary Actions
docs.text:
Type Duration Warning 6 months Serious Warning 6 months Demerit 12 months Probation 12 months Expulsion —

During the disciplinary period, eligibility for awards and honors is revoked, scholarship and financial aid eligibility is revoked, and student cadre positions are removed. Degree conferral is handled according to relevant regulations. Disciplinary action and removal records are filed in the student’s personal record.

docs.title: Exam-Related Disciplinary Actions
docs.text:
• Exam violation: Serious Warning
  • Exam cheating: Probation
  • Serious exam cheating: Expulsion

docs.title: Truancy Disciplinary Actions
docs.text:
Cumulative truancy in one semester (internships, military training, collective activities, etc., count as 6 class hours per day; unauthorized absence from school counts as 6 class hours per day):

Class Hours of Truancy Disciplinary Action Under 10 class hours Critical review 10–19 class hours Warning 20–29 class hours Serious Warning 30–39 class hours Demerit 40–49 class hours Probation 50 class hours or more Expulsion

docs.title: Other Key Points
docs.text:
• Committing a criminal offense, participating in drug use, prostitution, extortion, robbery, etc., results in expulsion
  • Theft of property valued at 500 yuan or more results in probation or more severe action
  • Academic misconduct: ghostwriting or buying/selling theses results in expulsion; plagiarism, tampering, or fabricating research results results in probation or more severe action
  • Three or more violations of school rules resulting in disciplinary action result in expulsion
  • After receiving disciplinary action, if the student shows remorse (comprehensive assessment in top 50%, active participation in social practice, etc.), they may apply for removal of disciplinary action 10 days before the end of the period (removal is not the same as revocation)

docs.title: Three-Level Determination
docs.text:
Category Examples of Behavior Consequences Exam violation Mobile phone or other non-exam items not placed in designated location, answering before being called / answering late, peeking or whispering, leaving the exam room without permission, taking the exam paper out of the exam room Grade of zero for that course, disqualification from make-up exams (may apply for retake); Serious Warning Exam cheating Carrying materials or electronic devices related to exam content (regardless of whether used), copying or assisting in copying, identical answers, tampering with grades Probation Serious exam cheating Proxy exam taking, using communication devices to cheat, repeat cheating, organizing group cheating, selling exam questions and answers Expulsion

The most easily overlooked violation

Bringing a mobile phone into the exam room and having it nearby counts as carrying electronic devices with exam-related content; regardless of whether you looked at it, it is considered cheating. Before entering the exam room, hand your mobile phone to the designated location; don’t take the risk.

Related sections

For how to enter the exam room, what items are prohibited, and how to review grades, see Exam Management Regulations.

docs.title: Reconsideration
docs.text: If you disagree with the exam violation determination, you may submit a written reconsideration application to the Academic Affairs Office within 5 working days from the date of announcement.

docs.title: Frequently Asked Questions
docs.text:
Q: How do I replace a lost student ID? A: Replacements are processed collectively during Week 5 and Week 15 of each semester. Fill out the "Qingdao University Student ID Application Form" and submit a one-inch bareheaded photo; the college will process it collectively through the Academic Affairs Office. If the original is found, it must be returned and canceled; you cannot hold two student IDs simultaneously.

Q: I’m sick and want to take leave to see a doctor. Who approves it? A: Up to 2 days, contact your counselor; 2–7 days, the college administrator; more than 7 days, the college principal. Leave exceeding 5 days requires proof from a Grade II-A or higher hospital. After returning from leave, you must report back; otherwise it counts as truancy.

Q: What happens if I take too much leave in a semester? A: If cumulative leave in a semester exceeds 6 weeks, you must complete leave of absence procedures. A single leave request cannot exceed 4 weeks; for special reasons, it cannot exceed 6 weeks.

Q: What happens if I fail an exam? A: You may take a make-up exam or retake the course (grades obtained through make-up exams or retakes will be marked). But cheating is not an option — cheating results in an automatic zero, disqualification from make-up exams, and a disciplinary record. During the disciplinary period, you lose eligibility for scholarships and honors, and it may even affect your degree. The loss far outweighs the gain.

Q: How can I get a postgraduate recommendation? A: Grade ranking in the top 30% (some majors may be more flexible), no failing grades in required courses, no disciplinary record, and CET-6 score of 426 or above (or IELTS 6 / TOEFL 80). Comprehensive score = Academic × 90% + Comprehensive Development Quality × 10%. For the complete strategy, see Exams and Grades – Postgraduate Recommendation.

Q: My family is in financial difficulty and I can’t afford tuition. What should I do? A: Use the "Green Channel" to enroll first, then apply for family financial difficulty identification (divided into general/difficulty/special difficulty tiers), National Financial Aid, origin-place student loans, work-study programs, etc. If you need help, contact your counselor or the Student Financial Aid Management Center directly; you will not be forced to drop out due to poverty. For how scholarships are evaluated and how to earn comprehensive assessment bonus points, see Comprehensive Assessment.

Currently, there are 156 registered clubs in the university, covering various fields such as ideology and politics, academic science and technology, culture and sports, volunteer welfare, innovation and entrepreneurship.

docs.title: Advice for Joining Clubs
docs.text:
Club Selection Advice

  • It is recommended to choose one or two clubs that you are truly interested in and stick with them
  • The number of clubs should not be too many to avoid attending meetings and rushing around all day, affecting studies
  • Some clubs may require a certain foundation, but most clubs only require interest and passing an interview to join
  • Participating in university-level clubs usually requires an interview
  • Clubs can exercise abilities and enrich resumes, but should not affect studies

Note

Club information on this page is continuously being collected. Specific welcome group numbers, activity times, and recruitment requirements for each club will be supplemented in subsequent updates. If you have more club information to share, contributions are welcome via GitHub.

docs.title: Budget Overview
docs.text:
Content based on 2026 unit budget

This article is compiled from "2026 Qingdao University Unit Budget" (Qingdao University's publicly released annual budget report). The budget is adjusted annually; this article reflects the initial budget arrangement for 2026, please refer to the university's official budget report for that year. The original report can be found at Qingdao University 2026 Unit Budget (Finance Office Official Website).

Although it has nothing to do with your living expenses, it's quite interesting to know how much your alma mater spends each year By the way: The university's money comes from government allocations, tuition and housing fees, and its own operating income, which is separate from your tuition fees. The first thing to do upon receiving the budget is to repay the university's bank loans (Yes, there's a repayment budget of over 60 million).

docs.title: In a Nutshell
docs.text: Qingdao University's total budget for 2026 is 2.769 billion yuan (2,769,051.6 thousand yuan), all allocated for education expenditure. Of this, 1.256 billion is used to ensure the university's normal operation (basic expenditure, mainly faculty and staff salaries), and 1.513 billion is used for various projects (project expenditure, such as research, scholarships, infrastructure, etc.).

docs.title: Where the Income Comes From
docs.text:
The total income budget for 2026 is 2,769,051.6 thousand yuan, with the following main sources:

Income Source Amount (10,000 yuan) Approx. Share Description Fiscal Appropriation Income 93,008.25 33.6% Provincial fiscal appropriation (general public budget) Carried Over from Previous Year 64,041.91 23.1% Unused funds from the previous year carried over for use this year (mainly research project funds) Fiscal Special Account Management Fund Income 46,605.00 16.8% Education fees such as tuition, housing fees, training fees (specially managed) Other Income 41,250.00 14.9% Interest, rental of fixed assets, operating income, etc. Business Income (excluding education fees) 32,000.00 11.6% Income from professional business activities

docs.text:

docs.text:

  • Goods and Service Expenditure approximately 78.74 million (office, utilities, maintenance, travel, and other daily operations)
  • Subsidies to Individuals and Families approximately 101 million (pension, survivor benefits, etc.)

Points Relevant to You

  1. Scholarships and Grants: National scholarships and grants budget 114 million + university-level student scholarships and grants 30 million, covering undergraduate national grants (per capita subsidy standard approx. 3,700 yuan/year), graduate grants, scholarships, work-study, hardship subsidies, etc.
  2. New Dormitories: New student dormitory construction at Fushan Campus, planned to add approximately 59,000 square meters of building area and approximately 4,000 new beds. Living conditions will improve after completion.
  3. Library: The teaching condition improvement project includes procurement of databases, journals, and e-books.

docs.title: Increase or Decrease Compared to the Previous Year?
docs.text: The 2026 revenue and expenditure budget is 2,769,051.6 thousand yuan, a decrease of 210,584.1 thousand yuan from the previous year (a decrease of approximately 7.1%). Main reasons: Fiscal initial budget appropriation has decreased, some projects are implemented with mid-year allocations; at the same time, the university has reduced loan income, optimized financial structure, and lowered financial costs.

docs.title: Other Things Worth Knowing
docs.text:
• "Three Public" Expenditures: In both 2025 and 2026, no general public budget appropriations have been arranged for "three public" expenditures (overseas travel for official business, official vehicles, official hospitality)
  • Government Procurement: The 2026 government procurement budget is 170,766.6 thousand yuan, of which 110 million for goods, 54.4826 million for services, and 6 million for engineering
  • State-owned Assets: As of December 31, 2025, the university has 3 official vehicles; equipment with a unit value of over 1 million yuan amounts to 182 units, and 19 more are planned for procurement in 2026
  • Internal Institutions: The university has 74 internal institutions (including colleges, functional departments, medical school colleges, research institutes, etc.), itself a secondary budget unit under the Shandong Provincial Department of Education, with no subordinate units

docs.title: Glossary of Terms
docs.text:
Term Meaning Fiscal Appropriation Funds allocated by the government finance to the university Fiscal Special Account Management Funds Education fees such as tuition, housing fees, managed in special accounts for specific uses Business Income Income from the university's business activities (excluding education fees) Carried Over from Previous Year Unused funds from the previous year carried over for use this year for the original purpose Basic Expenditure Expenditure to maintain normal university operation (personnel + daily public expenses) Project Expenditure Expenditure to complete specific tasks and objectives (research, infrastructure, scholarships, etc.) "Three Public" Expenditures Costs for overseas travel for official business, official vehicle purchase and operation, and official hospitality

Data source: "2026 Qingdao University Unit Budget", budget disclosure unit is in 10,000 yuan. Please refer to the university's official budget report for that year.

docs.title: Loss Reporting and Replacement
docs.text:
If your One-Card is lost:

  2. Go to a manual top-up location or self-service top-up machine to proceed

docs.title: Bathroom Use
docs.text:

docs.title: Application and Registration
docs.text:

docs.text: If your student ID is lost, you can bring your ID card or other valid documents to the Student Affairs Hall for replacement. Generally, there are two replacement opportunities per semester.

docs.title: Basic Information
docs.text:
• The campus network is WiFi, network names: QDU-1X and QDU-Web

docs.title: How to Apply
docs.text:
1. Find the link
  2. Follow the instructions to complete registration and payment
  3. Connect to QDU-1X or QDU-Web and log in with your account and password

About Campus Network

The campus network is not mandatory; choose according to your needs. At the start of school, you will receive a phone card from the university with complimentary campus data, which is usually sufficient if you only use mobile data.

docs.title: Mobile Phone Card
docs.text:
• The phone card provided by the university can be used once activated
  • After arriving at school, you can bring your ID card or other valid documents to the Mobile Business Hall to apply for CMCC-EDU wireless internet, broadband, and in-network calls.
  • You are not required to use the phone card included with the admission notice; you can choose your own. You can also apply on-site at the college on the registration day.
  • All carriers (China Mobile, China Unicom, China Telecom) have similar speeds on campus; choose based on personal preference.

docs.title: Dormitory Network
docs.text:
• Some dormitories can have wired internet (consult customer service yourself)
  • Jinjialing Campus West Campus can have China Telecom or China Mobile wired internet
  • Jinjialing Building No. 9 cannot have wired internet
  • Yingyuan Dormitory: China Mobile has fast but unstable speed, China Unicom is stable but average speed
  • Dormitories have 24-hour power supply, voltage 220V, high-power appliances are strictly prohibited
  • Starting from 2025, all dormitories are fully equipped with air conditioning, and all have heating.

docs.title: Academic Warning
docs.text:
Policy Basis

This page is compiled from the "Qingdao University Undergraduate Academic Warning Interim Management Measures" (Document No. QDU-Jiao [2015] 18), effective from the Class of 2014 onwards. If there are any changes, please refer to the latest documents from the Academic Affairs Office.

Academic warning is a system for the university to remind and provide targeted support to students who have developed learning problems or academic difficulties. It is conducted once per semester.

docs.title: Warning Levels
docs.text: Level Trigger Condition Yellow Warning Earning an average of fewer than 15 credits across two consecutive semesters; or accumulating 50%–70% failing grades in required courses Red Warning Earning an average of fewer than 15 credits across three consecutive semesters; or accumulating more than 70% failing grades in required courses

docs.title: Work Process
docs.text:
1. At the beginning of each semester, the department compiles students' academic situations, determines the academic warning list, and files it with the Academic Affairs Office
  2. The department issues the "Qingdao University Student Academic Warning Notice" to students and arranges dedicated personnel for academic guidance and support
  3. The department sends the "Qingdao University Student Academic Warning Parent Notification Letter" to students' parents, retaining mailing proof and receipts

docs.title: Support Requirements
docs.text:
• Students who receive a warning should promptly adjust their course plan under the guidance of their academic advisor. In principle, retaking failed required courses takes priority
  • For students who receive a red warning, the department will communicate with parents to jointly provide support

docs.title: Semester Structure
docs.text: Each semester consists of approximately 20 weeks: 18 weeks of course teaching + 2 weeks of review and exams. Graduating students have 18 teaching weeks total. Winter break is approximately 5 weeks, summer break approximately 7 weeks.
